data.abilityDescription: Monarchy soldiers use a variety of steam-powered packs for different functions both on and off the battlefield. Eltha’s pack is one of the most basic, using the steam produced by the pack for a variety of purposes.
data.level1Description: You cool the steam produced by your pack, producing 10 litres of water from a nozzle on the pack. The water can be used for a variety of purposes or sprayed to put out fires. The water is low-quality and not suitable for drinking, providing a sustenance rating of only 0.1 per litre.
data.level2Description: Emit a steam cloud from your steam pack, engulfing you and anyone in melee range of you in steam for three rounds. Anyone inside the steam or anyone attacking a target within the steam has a -5 to Strength (Attacking) checks.
data.level3Description: You can now launch the steam cloud up to one turn away at no extra Focus cost. You can also choose to heat your steam cloud to boiling levels for an extra 5 Focus, dealing D4 damage to anyone within the cloud on their turn, ignoring armour
data.level4Description: You can now emit a small, concentrated beam of steam from a nozzle on your steam pack. This beam is superheated, acting as a cutting torch, and can be used to cut through a lock or thin metal wall.
data.level5Description: You can now use your steam pack as a temporary steam engine to power a piece of technology for two hours. This can only be used once every 24 hours as the steam pack needs time to recharge itself.

data.abilityDescription: Ti’Giq’s’ military training included the use of Thermal Energy Gloves, a relatively basic Concordat technology that can increase or lower the thermal energy present in an area or object, and he has been given a pair to use on this mission.
data.level1Description: You can set a flammable object alight, superheat a metal object, or freeze a volume of water no bigger than yourself by touching it.
data.level2Description: When in combat, you can touch a plasma, laser or railgun weapon wielded by you or an ally within melee range and heat its energy battery as a minor action, causing its next attack to deal maximum damage (if it hits).
data.level3Description: When any damage that is caused by extreme heat or cold is dealt to you, spend 4 Focus to half it by adjusting the temperature around you to more suitable levels.
data.level4Description: Your Level 1 Thermal Energy Gloves can now be used to freeze any body of water, up to the size of a small lake.
data.level5Description: You can emit an aura of extreme heat or cold around you, either reducing the DEX of all enemies in melee range of you  by 1 as you chill them, or dealing 2 damage on their turn to them with extreme heat. Changing from one aura to the other takes a major action when in combat.

data.abilityDescription: Refusing to give up despite your great injuries, you get back to your feet, launching a devastating blow at your attackers.
data.level1Description: When you take damage that would down or kill you, you instead come back at 5 Health, and your next successful attack deals double damage. This can’t occur more than once every other fight.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A
data.level5Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: You are a devout follower of the Tai’Dara practices, having sworn off all advanced technology, genetic engineering and magic. Instead, you have trained your body to its peak, training in every field you can think of, and practising a variety of martial arts.
data.level1Description:
You cannot personally use any advanced technology, genetics or magic. However, your unarmed damage starts at 2+2D4. Every time you level up to a multiple of 5, the two dice you roll increases (to D6, then D8, then D10, then D12, then D20.) 
In addition, you now have two turns in each round of combat. Each turn is rolled separately in the turn order.
data.level2Description: When you perform a dice roll and draw with your opponent, you instead win, and you get a critically good effect as if you had rolled a natural 20.
data.level3Description: When you are damaged by an enemy melee attack, redirect the damage, dealing it to your attacker instead. This damage ignores any armour.
data.level4Description: Negate any stun, debuff, loss of control or status effect used against you. This includes being disarmed or grappled. This can be used whilst under the effect or as it is used against you and does not cost an action.
data.level5Description: Pass a check (assuming it is possible to be passed). This can be done after rolling for the check.

data.abilityDescription: You invert the friend/foe systems of an enemy mech or drone, causing them to view their former allies as enemy targets and turn on them.
data.level1Description: Interfere with the systems of a non-sentient mechanical enemy. For the next D3 rounds, they will fight on your side, attacking their allies. You can spend an additionally 2 Focus to specify a particular enemy that your target should attack.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A
data.level5Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: You are a fast fighter, dodging your opponent’s attacks with incredible speed, leaving them open for you to make devastating attacks against them.
data.level1Description: If you dodge an attack with a dodge roll at least 5 higher than the enemy’s attack roll, you gain a minor action. If you dodge an attack with a dodge roll at least 10 higher than the enemy’s attack roll, you gain a major action.
data.level2Description: If an enemy has 4 or less Health, you may spend 5 Focus to automatically knock them out without needing to make a check. This can be done as a minor action.
data.level3Description: You may now gain multiple major and minor actions from a single dodge roll using Level 1 of this ability.
data.level4Description:
When you attack, you can spend an additional major action, or 2 minor actions, to do any of the following. Multiple of these can be used multiple times in a single attack:
Your attack automatically hits
Your attack deals maximum weapon damage
Your damage is halved, with the other half being taken out of your target’s Focus
Your target loses 1 Armour
data.level5Description: Deal your Max Health as damage to an enemy in melee range of you. This takes 2 major and 2 minor actions to use.

data.abilityDescription: Intercepting your enemy’s attack, you strike at their arms, potentially knocking their weapon from their grasp.
data.level1Description: After you successfully dodge an enemy attack in melee range, deal 3 damage to that enemy, with a 20% chance to instantly disarm them.

data.abilityDescription: You can switch between your normal appearance, and an alternate appearance. This appearance can be of another normal person, or a stranger form, such as a humanoid demon or shadowy figure.
data.level1Description: Transform into an alternate appearance. People don’t recognise you in this alternate appearance, assuming you transform out of their sight. You can remain in your alternate appearance as long as you want, and changing back into your normal form doesn’t cost any Focus.

data.abilityDescription: You use your weapon to deflect attacks, cutting arrows out of the air, intercepting bullets with your own or knocking aside enemy blows, although the energy expended during this effort reduces your ability to retaliate.
data.level1Description: You always go at the end of the turn order. At the start of every round, roll your weapon damage. For the rest of that round, whenever you are dealt damage, you can reduce the number you rolled by X to reduce the damage dealt to you by X. The first time you attack that round, instead of rolling for damage, you deal however much damage you have left after the deductions.

data.abilityDescription: Through a natural ability of your race, you are able to walk atop the surface of the water without falling in, allowing you to traverse rivers and oceans as if they were land.
data.level1Description: You can walk on water, although falling over will cause you to fall into the water.

data.abilityDescription: Contact with eldritch beings beyond mortal understanding has shattered your mind, and whilst you have good days and bad days, you can be a liability to your teammates if not controlled.
data.level1Description: You have an Insanity Level that ranges from 1-5. At the beginning of each day, you roll a D5 to determine your Insanity Level. For each Insanity Level, your damage increases by 2, but you have a 10% chance to attack a random target every time you attack. This effect stacks.
data.level2Description: Your Mindset rating when using the Needs system is randomly determined by rolling a D5.
data.level3Description: You can now speak and understand all languages.
data.level4Description: At the start of each day, two of your stats (determined randomly) are enhanced, meaning that when rolling for checks in that stat, you roll twice and take the higher result. However, one of your stats (determined randomly) is weakened, meaning that when rolling for checks in that stat, you roll twice and take the lower result.
data.level5Description: Once a day, you can expose a target in melee range to the true extent of what you have seen, causing them to suffer the same insanity effects you are suffering for the rest of that day. This does not take an action to do.

data.abilityDescription: You always carry your favourite stuffed teddy with you. Holding him close in scary times can help you feel brave and convince you to keep going.
data.level1Description: Gain +1 to any Willpower check. This does not take an action to do and can be done after rolling.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A
data.level5Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: Although infiltration and words are Harriet’s primary weapons of choice, sometimes she has to get her hands dirty. Her weapons are coated in a Civilised poison that increases bleeding and weakens her foes.
data.level1Description: Whenever an enemy is damaged by one of your weapons, they take an additional 1 damage on their next turn, ignoring armour.
data.level2Description: Whenever an enemy is damaged by one of your weapons, they take an additional 2 damage on their next turn, ignoring armour.
data.level3Description: Whenever an enemy is damaged by one of your weapons, they take an additional 2 damage on their next turn, ignoring armour, and their STR and DEX are reduced by 1 until the end of combat. This effect doesn’t stack.
data.level4Description: Whenever an enemy is damaged by one of your weapons, they take an additional 2 damage on their next turn, ignoring armour, and their STR and DEX are reduced by 2 until the end of combat. This effect doesn’t stack.
data.level5Description: Whenever an enemy is damaged by one of your weapons, they take an additional 2 damage on their next turn, ignoring armour, and their STR and DEX are reduced by 2 until the end of combat.. This effect doesn’t stack. If you roll a critical hit on your attack roll, you deal maximum damage.

data.abilityDescription: You are an expert in one particular thing, able to succeed in it in almost any situation. However, this expertise has left you less effective in all other areas.
data.level1Description: At the start of the game, pick a specialty. You can pass a check in that specialty for 1 Focus. However, you have a -1 to all other checks.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A
data.level5Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: You can spend some time to analyse a target, allowing you to figure out some of their skills or unique capabilities, as well as how many of these abilities they may have.
data.level1Description: Learn a random ability of a humanoid that you don’t already know. This ability cannot be used if you know all the target’s abilities already.
data.level2Description: Learn how many abilities a humanoid target has, as well as how many are passive and how many are active. This can be used as a minor action.
data.level3Description: You may use Level 1 of this ability multiple times as a single major action.
data.level4Description: When using Level 1 of this ability, you can now specify if you would like to learn a passive or active ability, ask for the highest or lowest cost ability you don’t already know, or ask about abilities that are based off an item.
data.level5Description: This ability can now be used on non-humanoid targets, assuming you pass an intelligence roll relevant to the target. This roll will vary from 10+ to 25+ depending on the target.

data.abilityDescription: You have a very friendly lizard, created in the same way as the Cabre. It is useless in combat and cannot even walk very fast, either slowly following its owner or being carried. However, it is very lovable, and people are naturally drawn to it.
data.level1Description: You have a friendly Haemordial Lizard. The lizard cannot do very much, slowly following its owner around or being carried. The lizard gives a +2 bonus to Willpower (Morale) checks to all allies around it, and you gain a +2 to Charisma checks if you work the lizard into them. The lizard has no mob sheet.
data.level2Description: The lizard now provides a +1 to the Mindset of anyone sleeping within visual sight of it.
data.level3Description: The lizard can now provide a distraction out of combat. The lizard must pass a 13+ Luck check to see if bystanders are charmed or disgustingly intrigued by it.
data.level4Description: You can now send the lizard to slowly scout out areas, collect items and can give it more complex instructions. However, the lizard is not very bright, and you must pass a 11+ Charisma (Animal Handling) in order for it to understand what you are saying.
data.level5Description: The lizard has now developed a taste for food. For every 5 sustenance you feed the lizard, it buds, creating a copy of itself. These copies will obey instructions the same way as the original lizard for 24 hours, after which they become unintelligent and untamed.

data.abilityDescription: You line up a shot and fire a bullet that ignites on contact with the enemy, burning them.
data.level1Description: Shoot at a target, dealing 5 damage, and an extra 3 damage a round for three rounds. This attack cannot miss.
data.level2Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: Although Borr does use the directed energy weapons favoured by the Concordat, they prefer melee combat, using the slight morphing capabilities of Rowd and significant genetic engineering to turn their arms into sharp blades.
data.level1Description: You can transform your arms into blades as a minor action. Your Blade Arms are a D6 Wounding Medium Melee weapon. Turning your arms back into normal arms costs a minor action. Whilst your blade arms are active, you cannot pick up anything or do anything that requires the use of your hands.
data.level2Description: When you kill an enemy with your Blade Arms, any leftover damage can be applied to another target in melee range of you. This does not continue if the second target also dies with damage left over.
data.level3Description: Your Blade Arms now deal 2D6 damage.
data.level4Description: You can now change your arms into blades and back without using an action.
data.level5Description: Your Blade Arms are now long and thin, turning them into a piercing weapon and allowing them to ignore armour. This change is permanent. OR You can now attack with your Blade Arms as a minor action, dealing 1D6 damage. This does not remove the ability to attack as a major action.

data.abilityDescription: You spin with blades outstretched, cutting through surrounding enemies, injuring tougher enemies and potentially killing weak opponents.
data.level1Description: Deal 5 damage to all enemies in melee range of you. This can only deal damage to a maximum of ten enemies.
data.level2Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: You have technology that allows you to create a gradient of electrons, generating powerful bolts of electricity, as well as generating an electron shield around that can recharge using electricity.
data.level1Description: When you take electricity damage, you take 2D4 less damage, and gain Focus equal to the amount of damage reduced.
data.level2Description: Teleport in a bolt of electricity to any location within three turns of you. You deal 2 damage to any enemies within melee range of you when you land.
data.level3Description: Target an enemy within one turn of you and spend both your major and minor action to begin charging a bolt of electricity. On your next turn, spend your major and minor actions to launch the bolt at an enemy. The bolt cannot miss and deals 4D6 damage. You can cancel your bolt on your second turn instead of firing it, causing it to cost no Focus.
data.level4Description: Shoot a stream of electricity at an enemy within one turn of you, automatically grappling them. Whilst they are grappled, they take D4 damage a round, ignoring armour. Unlike a normal grapple, you do not suffer a -2 penalty to your Endurance (Fatigue) every round you are grappling the target, and the target must roll Endurance (Pain) instead of Strength (Might) to try and escape the grapple. You can cancel this grapple at any time as a minor action.
data.level5Description: When you use your Level 3 Lightning Magic, you can spend 5 Focus to chain your lightning bolt to another target. This can be used multiple times to chain the bolt to additional enemies. The bolt deals 1D6 less damage for each target it is chained to, meaning it cannot be used to damage more than 4 enemies in total. This can be chained back to the same target, given there is another target to chain off.

data.abilityDescription: The Hraf Z-12 Formula is a potent toxin that eats away at those infected, eventually transforming them into a smooth, black featureless husk known as an Inanimate, that are used for a variety of purposes by the Raven Captains.
data.level1Description: When you damage an enemy, you can spend 3 Focus to infect them with the Hraf Z-12 formula. This deals an extra D3 damage to them, ignoring armour, on their next turn. This uses up your minor action.
data.level2Description: When you infect an enemy with the Hraf Z-12 formula, you can spend extra Focus. For every 2 extra Focus you spend, the target remains infected for an extra round, taking D3 damage, ignoring armour, on their turn. Extending the duration of the infection is this way does not take an action.
data.level3Description: Any target that dies as a result of the damage of your Hraf Z-12 infection becomes a faceless Inanimate that will follow your commands for 24 hours before dying. The Inanimate has no stats and deals D3 Wounding damage.
data.level4Description: A target is now transformed into an Inanimate if they are killed whilst infected, regardless of what kills them.
data.level5Description: Any target killed by an Inanimate is also transformed into an Inanimate.

data.abilityDescription: Your ship is equipped with a Non-Organic Union Lance, a powerful weapon that can burn through any armour and fries whatever system it comes into contact with.
data.level1Description: Your ship has a Non-Organic Union Lance weapon, which ignores armour and deals 4D6 damage. It also instantly destroys any system it hits, as opposed to merely damaging it. The Lance Beam costs 6 Fuel to fire.

data.abilityDescription: Wherever Barbarians go, they leave trail signs, warning others of their kind of threats, or pointing them towards resources. This helps those who can recognise them to avoid the perils of the wilds.
data.level1Description: On a random encounter table, you are told the name of the encounter as well as adjacent encounters, and can pick which of the three to do. For long distance travel, you are told the elements within an encounter (but not their favourabilities) and can pick one to increase the favourability of by 2.

data.abilityDescription: You live for revenge. It sustains you, and you are drawn to those who have wronged you. When you find them, you strike with incredible ferocity, warping the landscape around the locations of their deaths.
data.level1Description: You are equipped with a weapon in a weapon group of your choice that deals 1/3rd of your targets max Health, rounding up. This damage ignores armour. You can dematerialise this weapon and rematerialise it into your hand from anyway as a minor action. However, you cannot deal any damage to those who have not wronged you.
data.level2Description: You no longer need to eat, drink, breathe or sleep. You recover all of your Focus at midnight. However, you can no longer recover Health through First Aid, healing items or the Needs system.
data.level3Description: Against targets who have wronged you, you can spend 7 Focus to reroll any check. You are also drawn to those who have wronged you, allowing you to head towards them, although you do not instinctively know their location, merely what direction they are in.
data.level4Description: Deal your weapon damage to all enemies within melee range of you, assuming you have a clear path to them. This can be extended out to deal your weapon damage to all enemies within one turn of you for an extra 10 Focus.
data.level5Description: Every time you kill a major figure who has wronged you, a circle with a diameter of one mile is formed at the location of their death. Within the circle, you roll 2D20 for all stats, and can shape the area to an aesthetic of your choosing, although the layout of the area stays the same.

data.abilityDescription: You are afflicted with a chronic magical pain as your body overflows with energy. This magic flares up, causing incredible pain and building up in your body, as long as you are able to contain it.
data.level1Description: At random times you will be struck with a burst of magical energy, which you can choose to hold back with a 9+ Willpower (Pain) check. Every time you pass the check, future checks increase in difficulty by 3 and you add a D4 to any magic-based rolls. This resets when you fail one of these checks. In addition, when you fail one of these checks, you take 3 damage for every consecutive check you had passed, are stunned for a number of rounds equal to the number of consecutive checks you had passed divided by 2, and release a massive burst of magical energy, sound and light.

data.level3Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: You wield both Shadow and Light energies. These conflicting forces combine in your body in strange ways, constantly pulling you between the shadow and the light.
data.level1Description: You are wreathed in Shadowlight, granting you a Shadow form and a Light form. When in Shadow form, you have +2 STR and +2 END (also giving you +4 Max Health). When in Light Form, you have +2 INT, +2 PER and +4 Max Focus. Rather than choosing which form you are in, whenever you roll a D4 as part of a Shadowlight ability, you change to your shadow form if you roll a 1 or a 2, or your Light Form if you roll a 3 or a 4.
data.level2Description: When in Shadow Form, you gain a +1 to all checks you make in combat. When in Light Form, you gain a +1 to all checks you make outside of combat.
data.level3Description: When in Shadow Form, you cannot be taken by surprise and any stealth attacks performed against you are treated as normal attacks. When in Light Form, you automatically have a 5 to your Mindset when using the Needs System.
data.level4Description: When in Shadow Form, you are aware of any individuals nearby with malicious or selfish intent and have a +4 to Charisma checks when interacting with them. When in Light Form, you are aware of any individuals with selfless or positive intent and have a +4 to Charisma checks when interacting with them.
data.level5Description: Now, when you roll a D4 as part of a Shadowlight ability, you can choose which form to be in if you roll a 2 or a 3.

data.abilityDescription: As a Griot of the Lion Clan, you have the attributes of a Lion, including a large mane, long claws and a regal bearing. As your skill grows, you can even transform into a lion hybrid that inspires your allies.
data.level1Description: Gain +5 to a Charisma (Intimidation) check. This must be done before rolling for the check and does not take an action to do in combat.
data.level2Description: You can now Charge for full damage, and using Charge no longer costs Focus.
data.level3Description: You have D12 Slashing Claws (Melee only). You have a +2 to hit when attacking with your Claws.
data.level4Description: When you have to make an Endurance check, you can add your Willpower modifier instead of your Endurance modifier. This does not take an action to do in combat, and must be done before you roll for the check.
data.level5Description: Transform into a full Sur-Human/Lion hybrid for an hour. When in your Hybrid form, you gain +5 STR, and +3 WIL. All allies around you gain a +1 to all of their checks. However, you can only attack with your Claws.

data.abilityDescription: You are outfitted with a headcap that gives you a pleasurable shock of electrical energy whenever you kill, designed to encourage savagery and ruthlessness amongst Drarganian soldiers.
data.level1Description: Gain 4 Focus whenever you deal the killing blow to an enemy.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A
data.level5Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: Sizing up your enemy, you deliver a precise attack that exposes their weakest point, allowing allies to deal greater damage. A more powerful version of this strike also hurts the enemy, weakening them.
data.level1Description: Strike a target, exposing their weakness. The target takes two more damage from all attacks for the rest of the combat. This damage may not exceed the maximum damage of the weapon used in the attack. This ability can be done as a minor action for an extra 3 Focus.
data.level2Description: Strike a target, dealing D4 damage and exposing their weakness. The target takes two more damage from all attacks for the rest of the combat. This damage may not exceed the maximum damage of the weapon used in the attack. This ability can be done as a minor action for an extra 3 Focus.
data.level3Description: Strike a target, dealing D4 damage and exposing their weakness. The target takes two more damage from all attacks for the rest of the combat. This damage may not exceed the maximum damage of the weapon used in the attack. The target can now be critically hit on a 19 or a 20. This ability can be done as a minor action for an extra 3 Focus.
data.level4Description: Strike a target, dealing D4 damage and exposing their weakness. The target takes two more damage from all attacks and deals two less damage with all attacks for the rest of the combat. This damage may not exceed the maximum damage of the weapon used in the attack. The target can now be critically hit on a 19 or a 20. This ability can be done as a minor action for an extra 3 Focus.
data.level5Description: Strike a target, dealing D4 damage and exposing their weakness. The target takes two more damage from all attacks and deals two less damage with all attacks for the rest of the combat. The target can now be critically hit on a 19 or a 20. This ability can be done as a minor action for an extra 3 Focus.

data.abilityDescription: You are a master of controlling the battlefield, pulling enemies in and knocking them away, with you and your allies striking at them all the while.
data.level1Description: Knock an enemy in melee range of you one turn away or pull an enemy one turn away from you into melee range. This ability can be used as a minor action.
data.level2Description: When you attack an enemy, you knock them to the ground, forcing them to lose their minor action on their next turn as they get back up. This ability can be done as a minor action and doesn’t require you to successfully hit the enemy.
data.level3Description: Once a round, you can use Level 1 or 2 of this ability without using up an action.
data.level4Description: Whenever an enemy enters or exits melee range of you, deal D4 damage to them. The damage type is the same as your weapon’s damage type.
data.level5Description: When an enemy enters or exits melee with an ally as a result of this ability, that ally deals D4 damage to them. The damage type is the same as your ally’s weapon damage type.

data.abilityDescription: You are trained in the use of a single, one-handed weapon. You are quick, accurate and damaging, able to harass your enemies, shoot their weapons out of their hands, and gun them down in high-risk duels.
data.level1Description: If you are wielding a single, one-handed ranged weapon, you can attempt to disarm an enemy at range by shooting their weapon out of their hand. This disarm follows the same rules as an ordinary disarm manoeuvre. The other levels of this ability can also only be used when wielding a single, one-handed ranged weapon.
data.level2Description: You always go first in the turn order. The first attack you launch in a battle cannot miss.
data.level3Description: Shoot an enemy in a vital spot, causing them to lose one armour. This can only be used once per enemy and can be done as a minor action.
data.level4Description: You fire a quick shot at an enemy, dealing 1 damage, ignoring armour. This ability does not take an action to do and can be used anytime, whether or not it is your turn.
data.level5Description: You and an enemy make a Strength (Attacking) check against each other. If you win, then you launch an attack, automatically hitting and dealing double your maximum weapon damage. If you lose, then the enemy deals their maximum weapon damage to you. This only costs 5 Focus if you lose the check.

data.abilityDescription: You wield a firearm built into your arm, allowing you to conceal your weapon and use it without fear of it being taken from you.
data.level1Description: You can slot one ranged weapon into your arm, allowing your arm to transform between its normal appearance and the ranged weapon. You cannot be disarmed of this weapon in combat.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: Powered by a perpetually burning furnace, the irremovable Hellhound Exoskeleton drastically increases the durability of its wielder, whilst also carrying a variety of flame-based defences and weaponry that can be used to deadly effect.
data.level1Description: Gain Health equal to your Endurance Modifier for an hour or until you finish a combat encounter, whichever comes sooner. This can be done as a minor action. Losing this extra Health when the ability expires cannot drop you below 1 Health.
data.level2Description: You heat the plates of your Hellhound suit to great temperatures, causing any enemy that successfully attacks you in melee to take 2 damage, ignoring armour. This can be done as a minor action and lasts until the end of combat or an hour, whichever comes sooner.
data.level3Description: When an enemy attacks you, spend 2 Focus to use Endurance (Impact) instead of Dexterity (Dodging).
data.level4Description:
Pick One:
Any fire-based weapon you wield deals 2 extra damage
OR
Your Hellhound Exoskeleton now gives you 1 extra armour (Heavy Armour).
data.level5Description: When you reduce an enemy to two or less Health with a fire-based weapon, you instead reduce them to zero Health as flames eat away at them.

data.abilityDescription: You are rarely noticed, to the point where even your allies can forget you are there. However, this can benefit you in combat, where enemies are more likely to go after your more imposing, intimidating allies.
data.level1Description: You have a -2 to Willpower (Presence) checks. However, when an enemy goes to attack you in combat, there is a 50% chance that they will instead choose to attack someone else, unless you are the only target within attackable range.

data.level1Description: You have a +5 to Dexterity (Initiative) checks when rolling to avoid being disarmed.

data.abilityDescription:
You are trained in the incredibly precise art of runecarving, using a magically imbued gouge to carve intricate runes. The gouge immediately imbues these runes with magic, and as you study runes out in the world, you can create more and more complex effects by combing runes in new and interesting ways.
(This ability has additional supporting information)
data.level1Description: You have access to 5 different simple Runes, to be agreed upon with your DM. These can be carved onto items, with each item having a number of runes that can be carved on it (known as Rune Slots). A rune can be carved an unlimited number of times. Once a Rune is carved, that Rune Slot is filled, even if the rune is removed (removing a rune can be done at any time). Each simple Rune costs 6 Focus, takes D6 hours to carve, and has a different active effect. Adding multiple runes of the same type to an item increases the potency of the runes.
data.level2Description:
You can study runes you find, for a cost of 4 Focus and 2 hours of research time per rune. When studying runes, make an Intelligence (Languages) check for each rune. Each rune on a specific item can only be studied once. The check result determines the outcome:
1-5: you learn nothing and destroy the runed object.
6-10: You learn nothing, but the runed object is undamaged
11-19: You gain an unlock point towards the rune you studied. Most simple runes need 2 unlock points to learn
20-29: You instantly learn the rune you have studied, allowing you to carve it.
30+: As well as learning the rune, you also learn another simple rune related to the rune you have learned.
data.level3Description: When you carve a rune, you can now carve it in such a way that it provides a weaker, but always active passive effect, as opposed to an active effect.
data.level4Description: You can now learn complex runes, which are learned in the same way as simple runes. Complex runes are more powerful but take up two rune slots on an item. Carving a complex rune costs 10 Focus and takes 2D4 hours. In addition, removing a rune from an item now opens up the rune slot, allowing another rune to be carved in its place.
data.level5Description:
You can now carve two simple runes into a single rune slot
OR
Complex runes now only take up a single rune slot.

However, your mind is dulled, doubling any Focus costs outside of this ability unless you pass a 14+ Willpower (Resistance) check. This check must be made each time you use Focus outside of this ability.
data.level2Description: You can morph your hands into any shape with non-moving parts. If you change your hands into the shape of a weapon, it has the damage type most suitable to the shape, deals 1D10 damage and you are skilled when attacking with it. Turning your hands into very precise shapes, such as keys or similar items, requires a 9+ Dexterity (Precision) check.
data.level3Description: You no longer need to breathe and are immune to any non-magical poisons or diseases, unless they affect metal. You also no longer eat or drink, always having a sustenance rating of 5, and no longer sleep, instead using the needs system whilst resting when awake, allowing you to maintain full awareness.
data.level4Description: The first time you are attacked in a combat encounter, you automatically counterattack, regardless of whether you are hit or not. This counterattack either cannot miss or deals maximum weapon damage (you choose which option just before the counterattack).
data.level5Description: Any incidental or environmental damage (or any other kind of damage with no intent behind it) dealt to you is divided by 4.

data.level1Description: Once a day, you can spend 2 hours to make a meal. To do this, make an Intelligence (Nature) and a Dexterity (Precision) check and add the final check results together. This combined total can also be modified by up to -10 or +10 depending on the available ingredients and equipment. You create a meal that restores total sustenance equal to half your final result that can be split however you wish.
data.level2Description: You are in possession of a pair of self-heating rocks which can be used to boil water and cook food. The rocks cannot set anything alight.
data.level3Description:

Vegetables – +3 max and current Focus.
Fish – When you draw on a check, you instead win.
Carbs – When downed, you have one additional round before you die.
Heavily Spiced (3+ spices) – You may use one ability at one level higher once.
data.level4Description: Food prepared or added to by you provides an additional one sustenance.
data.level5Description: When making food, you can spend 6 Focus to either half the time taken to create the food or allow you to reroll a dice involved in the making of the food.

data.level2Description: When you pass a Charisma (Charm) check against someone, you can make another Charisma (Charm) check against their Willpower (Pressure). This can only be done once per individual, but you can have bonuses from multiple individuals at once.
data.level3Description: You emit an aura of attraction, meaning that anyone has the potential to be attracted to you, regardless of their sexuality. This does not mean that Charisma (Charm) checks against them automatically succeed.
data.level4Description: When you are sexually intimate with someone, you can learn three pieces of information of your choice, assuming the person you were intimate with knows that information.
data.level5Description: Tell someone you have seduced or been physically intimate with to do something they wouldn’t ordinarily do. The target must pass a Willpower (Pressure) check, or they must carry out the command. The difficulty of the check can range from 6-20 depending on how unwilling they are to carry out that command, with the check difficulty decreasing the more unwilling they are to do the task. Every time you use this on a target, they get a +3 bonus to all future checks for this ability. This bonus stacks.

data.abilityDescription: You can create deadly locks that can only be opened by injecting the opener with a deadly poison that is very difficult to remove, although the damage caused by the poison itself is still curable.
data.level1Description: Create a spiked, poisonous lock to seal an entryway or container. The lock can be unlocked with a Dexterity (Lockpicking) or Intelligence (Computing) (depending on the setting) check equal to your modifier in that stat plus 8, or by pricking a finger on the spike. Opening the lock in the latter way poisons the person who opened it, dealing 10% of their Max Health as damage every five minutes for an hour. This can only be cured with a 13+ Intelligence (Anatomy) check. This healing check can only be attempted twice on the poisoned target.

A target poisoned by one of your Poison Locks can now no longer be cured with an Intelligence (Anatomy) check.

When someone attempts to unlock one of your locks with a check, you are aware of it.

data.level2Description:
You can spend 1 Soul to increase the damage of one of your attacks by 2 or decrease the damage of an enemy attack by 1. This does not take an action to do.
You can also now spend 3 Souls to gain an Overcharge as a minor action.
data.level3Description: You can now spend souls to heal yourself when downed.
data.level4Description: For every three enemies you damage in combat that die within the same combat, you gain a soul, even if you did not deal the killing blow.
data.level5Description: If you deal the killing blow to a willing victim, you gain 3 souls.

data.level1Description:
Roll a D4. The result determines what spell you cast:
1: Heal a target for 2D8 Health.
2: Burn a target for 2D6 damage. They take 2 damage on their turn for the next two rounds, ignoring armour.
3: Blind all enemies within one turn of you for a round, and cause them to lose their minor action.
4: Stun a target and all enemies within melee range of that target for a round.
data.level2Description: You can now spend an extra 3 Focus to reroll the D4 if you want. You can only do this once per use of the ability and you must use the new result to determine which spell you cast
data.level3Description:
Each spell improves:
1: You now heal a target for 10 Health.
2: The burned enemy now takes 3 damage on their turn for two rounds.
3: You now also knock back all enemies within one turn of you.
4: Enemies are now frozen instead of stunned.
data.level4Description: Rather than rolling a D4, you can now choose which season to use when casting this spell.
data.level5Description: Launch a blast of all four seasons, dealing 3D6 damage to all enemies within one turn of you, and causing them to take 3 damage on their turn for two rounds. Any enemies hit are frozen for a round and any allies within one turn of you are healed for 10 Health.

data.level2Description: Your character has five books on them. Pick an intelligence specialty for each book, representing that book’s topic. data.level4Description: You can now use multiple books for a single Intelligence check, providing all books are for the correct specialty.
data.level5Description: Now, when you pick your books, you can choose not to define what specialty a book is, at a cost of 4 Focus per book. data.abilityDescription: You have spent more time at sea than you have on land, and whilst you may be a bit wobbly when off a ship, you more than make up for it when on a ship.
data.level1Description: When at sea, you have a +2 to all Strength, Endurance and Dexterity checks. When on land, you have a -1 to all Strength, Endurance and Dexterity checks.
data.level2Description: You are attuned to the needs of your crewmates, and instantly pass Perception (Empathy) checks when judging the emotional state of your fellow crew.
data.level3Description: You have a +2 to your Mindset when sleeping at sea. This cannot raise your Mindset above a 5.
data.level4Description: In each port you visit, you know someone. When you first visit that port, roll a D20 to see how useful this person is, with a higher check result being a more useful contact.
data.level5Description: When on a ship, if a situation occurs where you would go overboard, you instead don’t. This can only occur once per day.

data.abilityDescription: Your powers over the dead allow you to create spirits. These spirits can be weak, faceless shades with no personality, or powerful champions that retain the skills they had in life.
data.level1Description: Raise the spirit of a corpse within two turns of you as a Shade. The Shade cannot dodge and dies when damaged. Its attacks deal 1 damage, ignoring armour. If there are more than double the number of Shades as there are enemies in a combat encounter, then Shades automatically hit. Up to four Shades can be raised as a single major action.
data.level2Description: As a minor action, you can destroy any number of your Shades, no matter their location, healing yourself for 1 Health per Shade destroyed.
data.level3Description: Spend an hour raising the spirit of a corpse within two turns of you as a Spirit Champion. A Spirit Champion has the mob or character sheet that it had in life, as well as the same appearance, albeit translucent and ghostly. Undead Champions retain their broad personality, but now have the morals of the one who raised them and will follow that person’s commands.
data.level4Description: When an Undead Champion is killed, you are aware of it, as well as where they died.
data.level5Description: Shades can now be raised as a minor action.

data.abilityDescription: A common blessing given by Great Beasts, the blessing of ferocity encourages those who have it to kill in order to keep themselves alive.
data.level1Description: Whenever you deal the killing blow to an enemy, you heal for 2 Health.

data.level1Description: When you are about to be ambushed or surprised, make an 11+ Perception (Touch) check. If you succeed, you can act before you are surprised.

data.abilityDescription:
The City has numerous reputable mercenary groups that can be called upon in times of need, assuming you have the necessary contracts signed. These mercenaries are quick to arrive and are incredibly loyal, although some will not be willing to throw their lives away for you.
(This ability has additional supporting information)
data.level1Description: Call in three S.P.I.R.I.T Mercenaries. The team will scout out a building or equivalent-sized area before leaving, or will follow and assist you until you dismiss them, run out of Focus or until they die. The team takes ten minutes to arrive after being called in and can only be called into an area they could realistically reach.
data.level2Description: Call in three Walker Recobot Mercenaries. The Walker Recobots can create a variety of devices out of their own bodies. The Recobots can create three devices in total, after which they are all used up. The team takes a couple of minutes to arrive after being called in and can only be called into an area they could realistically reach.
data.level3Description: Call in five Dead Bolt Mercenaries to aid you in combat. The mercenaries will aid you against a particular force or faction that you assign that when called in, and will assist until you dismiss them, run out of Focus, or until they have all died or retreated. The team takes ten minutes to arrive after being called in and can only be called into an area they could realistically reach.
data.level4Description: Call in a Talos Enchanted Statue Mercenary to protect you and your allies. When called in, the Statue is assigned particular targets to protect, which it will do until you dismiss it, run out of Focus or it dies. The statue takes ten minutes to arrive after being called in and can only be called into an area it could realistically reach.
data.level5Description: You can now combine two mercenary teams to create a new unique individual that you can summon. This individual is not a mob, but instead provides a powerful effect. This unique individual costs the combined Focus cost of the two teams used to create it for one hour. The individual will assist you until you dismiss them, run out of Focus or until they die.

data.abilityDescription: As a skilled magic user of the Shadow Realm, you are capable of using souls for a variety of basic spells; creating hellfire, summoning hellhounds and weakening your enemies.
data.level1Description: Unleash a blast of hellfire, dealing 3 damage to a target within one turn of you. You can use multiple souls to increase the damage of this hellfire, at a cost of 1 Soul per 3 damage.
data.level2Description: Reduce an enemy’s stat modifier of your choice to zero for two rounds.
data.level3Description: Create two grasping hands that emerge from the ground and grab the legs of an enemy within one turn of you, preventing that enemy from moving, charging or performing any other action that requires a change in location until the hands are destroyed. Each hand is destroyed after 2 damage is dealt to it. Any attacks against a hand automatically hit.
data.level4Description: Summon up to 2 Hellhound Familiars at a cost of 2 Souls per Familiar. Each Hellhound Familiar has 6 Health, 8 Focus, +2 STR and +1 DEX, as well as a D6 Shocking Bite attack (Melee only).
data.level5Description: Temporarily raise a dead corpse that died within the last 24 hours to ask a question. The corpse has the stats it had in life and must answer the question truthfully and to the best of its knowledge unless it passes a 17+ Willpower (Resistance) check, at which point it can refuse to answer. After the corpse has answered the question (or refused to), it dies again.

data.abilityDescription: The true appearance of the Xangzi is known only to them, as anyone else that looks at them sees them as a member of their own species. It is unknown how this ability works, but it is capable of affecting even security footage and non-organic sensors.
data.level1Description: Whenever a species looks at you, they see you as a member of their species/make if viewed by a non-organic. This affects any visual observation, including pre-recorded footage and non-organic visual sensors.

data.abilityDescription: You are a powerful spirit, unbound from the mortal plane. This means you can fly, pass through walls and create an unearthly mist to disorient and terrify people.
data.level1Description: As well as walking, you can hover above the ground and fly.
data.level2Description: You can phase through unshielded, non-organic surfaces, allowing you to pass through them as if they weren’t there. This cannot be used on surfaces warded against spirits.
data.level3Description: Your walking, hovering and flight is now silent.
data.level4Description: Create a mist from your body that fills the room you are in or an area equal to two turns away from you, whichever is smaller. This fog reduces the stats of all enemies by two unless they pass a 16+ Willpower (Courage) check, and when making a stealth check within the fog, you roll two dice and take the higher result.
data.level5Description: You can teleport anywhere within your mist as a minor action, and when you speak in the fog, you can project your voice from anywhere within the fog or make it sound like it is coming from everywhere.

data.abilityDescription: As enemy attacks bounce futilely off your armour, you respond, launching a quick attack whilst they are distracted
data.level1Description: If an attack is completely absorbed by your armour, deal your weapon damage to the enemy that attacked you.

You carry with you a bag of weapons, containing everything from a small rock to magical blades. In battle, you draw a weapon randomly and leap into combat.
(This ability has additional supporting information)
data.level1Description: You are skilled in all weapon types but have no starting weapon. When you begin combat, you draw a random weapon from your bag of weapons and use that weapon for the rest of the battle, with the weapon going back into the bag when combat ends.

data.abilityDescription: The Hoddox are a conflicted race. Skilled at combat, but inherently peaceful, they are drawn to fight, but feel incredibly guilty after they do. Many Hoddox turn to alcohol and other substances to help deal with this, whilst others simply embrace their guilt, fighting near constantly.
data.level1Description: You deal 50% more damage with all attacks. This does not occur when you critically hit. However, you suffer a -5 to all non-combat checks for four hours after your most recent combat.
data.level2Description:
You now suffer a -2 to your Mindset rating the night after your most recent fight. However, you can now reduce the stat debuff this ability causes by 1, and reduce the negative modifier to your mindset by 1 for each of the following you do (each of these can only trigger once):
Getting drunk or otherwise intoxicated.
Saving someone’s life in a non-violent way that day.
data.level3Description:
You can now additionally reduce the stat debuff this ability causes by 1, and reduce the negative modifier to your mindset by 1 for each of the following: (each of these can only trigger once):
If the combat that caused the debuff was morally justified to your character.
If you did not personally kill anyone during the combat.
data.level4Description: You have the Brawling weapon skill. You can launch an unarmed attack as a minor action.
data.level5Description:
You can now permanently pick one of the following ways to offset this ability’s debuffs:
Getting drunk or otherwise intoxicated.
Saving someone’s life in a non-violent way that day.
If the combat that caused the debuff was morally justified to your character.
If you did not personally kill anyone during the combat.
That way now reduces the stat debuff this ability causes by 2 and reduces the negative modifier to your mindset by 2.

data.abilityDescription: Whilst humans may not have the strange biological abilities of many other species in the galaxies, they have a natural skill in weapons of all kinds, able to wield them and intuit how they work with little to no training.
data.level1Description: You are skilled with all weapon types.

data.abilityDescription: You are skilled in martial arts, striking with your fists and other body parts. Whilst these attacks are not necessarily the most damaging, they can knock enemies around, stun them, and allow you to act with greater speed.
data.level1Description: Your unarmed melee attacks ignore armour.
data.level2Description: Prepare yourself for incoming attacks. For one round, when rolling to dodge, you can roll twice and take the higher result. You can use this as a minor action.
data.level3Description: Strike an enemy in melee range of you in a pressure point, preventing them from moving, dodging, attacking or performing any action for a round. This can be done as a minor action assuming you do not attack with your major action the same turn.
data.level4Description: If you critically hit with an attack, you can now change that attack to an unarmed melee attack. If you do this, then instead of dealing double damage, you instead gain another major and minor action.
data.level5Description:
When you successfully hit an enemy with an unarmed melee attack, you can spend 4 Focus to do one of the following:
Knock them down, causing them to lose their next minor action.
Push them one turn away from you.
Lower their Focus by 3+D3
Reduces all of their stats by 1 for a round.
Using this does not take an action.

data.abilityDescription: Greville puts away his weapon and slams his arms down with immense force, crushing anyone in his path and knocking enemies back.
data.level1Description: Deal 2 damage to a target, and 1 damage to all enemies within melee range of your target. This attack cannot miss and ignores armour.
data.level2Description: Deal 4 damage to a target, and 3 damage to all enemies within melee range of your target. This attack cannot miss and ignores armour.
data.level3Description: Your Slam now knocks all enemies hit by it to the ground, forcing them to spend a minor action to get up before they can do anything else.
data.level4Description: Instead of knocking enemies to the ground, you can spend an extra 4 Focus to knock them a turn away from you.
data.level5Description: You can now target a single enemy with your Slam, concentrating all of the damage that would have been dealt to other enemies on that target.

data.abilityDescription: In battle, you work with your allies, retaliating against enemies that strike them, shielding and covering them and teaming up for powerful simultaneous attacks.
data.level1Description: When you attack an enemy, spend 4 Focus to allow an ally within melee range of you to move one turn immediately. This move does not take up an action for them.
data.level2Description: If you have any actions left when you end your turn, you can spend Focus to give them to an ally who is below you in the turn order. This costs 1 Focus per minor action you give them, and 3 Focus per major action you give them. This doesn’t take an action to do.
data.level3Description: When an ally within one turn of you is damaged, make an attack against the enemy that hit them, assuming they are within attack range. This attack deals D4 damage. This does not take an action to do.
data.level4Description: If you are in melee range of an ally and they are attacked, spend 4 Focus to split the damage equally between you and the ally. This does not take an action to do.
data.level5Description: If you and an ally are next to each other on the turn order, then during your turn, you can use up both your major action and your ally’s major action to both launch an attack against the same enemy, assuming that enemy is within attack range for both of you. These attacks have +5 to hit, deal double damage, and are treated as a single attack with regards to armour. This can only be done with the permission of the ally involved.

data.abilityDescription: You are equipped with a device that allows you to rewind time in a local area. Whilst not as powerful as full time travel, it is still a useful tool, it allows you to undo wounds, misspoken words and repair items.
data.level1Description: Rewind time around a wound that has been inflicted on you in battle, negating D6 damage. This can only be used immediately after the damage has been inflicted and cannot be used to heal more damage than was dealt to you. Using this ability uses up your next major action.
data.level2Description: Rewind time, erasing the last thing you or an ally said.
data.level3Description: You can rewind time after sleeping to get more sleep, removing any tiredness debuffs. This can be used on allies as well as yourself at a cost of 5 Focus per person. Some sleep has to have occurred to use this ability.
data.level4Description: Rewind time, rerolling a dice roll which has just happened. The new roll is taken regardless of whether it is better or worse than the original. This only costs a minor action if used in combat.
data.level5Description: Rewind time on an item, reverting it to a previous state. This can be used to recharge drained items, repair damaged items, or break recently repaired items.

data.abilityDescription:
You travel alongside an animal ally, whether a natural beast of Barbarus, or a magical creation of The City. These animals come in all shapes and sizes and can be used for anything from scouting to mounts, to beasts of war, depending on their species and capabilities.
(This ability has additional supporting information)
data.level1Description: You have an animal ally. What species your animal is should be  discussed with your GM before the start of the adventure, You construct your animal using points (more information is in the Supporting Documentation for this ability). You have 10 points to construct your animal out of.
data.level2Description: You gain 6 more points for your animal.
data.level3Description: You gain 6 more points for your animal.
data.level4Description: You gain 6 more points for your animal.
data.level5Description: You gain 10 more points for your animal.

data.abilityDescription: As you spend time with people and as they get to know you, you figure out how to get past their defences, their mental weaknesses and how best to manipulate and weaken them.
data.level1Description: For every 24 hours you have spent with someone as an ally, they have a -1 to Willpower checks made against you, up to a maximum of -5.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: Against those who wield magic, you are especially deadly. Your attacks shake their confidence, magic slides off you with a lessened effect, and you can negate their magic with your own.
data.level1Description: Become aware of the most powerful piece of magic within a few hours walking distance of you, and the approximate location of the magic.
data.level2Description: Reflect a non-damaging magical effect directed at you back at the individual who cast it.
data.level3Description: When you damage someone who has magical abilities, you can spend 5 Focus to cause them to lose Focus equal to half the damage you dealt them. This doesn’t take an action to do.
data.level4Description: Halve the effects of any magic used against you. This may half the damage of magic or any negative modifier applied to you, or half the potency or effectiveness of other magical effects. Using this doesn’t take up an action.
data.level5Description: Touch an item or person imbued with magic, or a magical phenomenon, and cancel it, causing any magical effects they have to end. Any permanent magical person, item or phenomenon regains its magic after an hour. The Focus cost of this ability depends on the power of the magic you are cancelling.

data.abilityDescription: The Remote Hacking Laser is a niche item used by inhabitants of The City when they need to access digital, non-cyberscene systems, allowing them to hack systems from a distance and through transparent surfaces.
data.level1Description: Shine the laser on a hackable device you can see, allowing you to hack it as if you were plugged into it. This does not increase the chance of you successfully hacking something.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: Many species can manipulate water through magical or natural abilities. Many others use technology to control and move water. No matter the method, water manipulation can be a powerful tool.
data.level1Description: You create 10 liters of water in an open space in front of you or create it falling from the sky as rain. The water can be used for a variety of purposes or sprayed to put out fires. The water can be drunk and has a sustenance rating of 0.3 per liter. A maximum of 2 sustenance per person can be gained by drinking water created by you.
data.level2Description: You summon a Water construct to aid you in combat. The construct has 7 Health, 6 Focus +2 STR and +1 END, as well as a D5 Crushing Bite attack (Melee only). The construct disappears at the end of combat.
data.level3Description: Control and manipulate the shape and position of water, with the Focus cost depending on the quantity of water manipulated and how much you want to move it.
data.level4Description: Summon a wave to knock over a target and all enemies in melee range of that target, forcing them to make a 13+ Dexterity (Acrobatics) or Endurance (Impact) check, losing their minor action if they succeed, and their major action if they fail.
data.level5Description: Summon a water tornado around an enemy. The tornado is filled with small water constructs that bite at the enemy, dealing 2 damage a round until the end of combat. You can summon tornados around multiple enemies as a single major action, at a cost of 6 Focus per tornado.

data.abilityDescription: Whilst not a full skin shed, Reptiliae can slip out of their outermost layer, leaving behind a decoy of moulted skin to draw enemy attention.
data.level1Description: Slip out of a thin layer of skin, leaving behind a decoy that cannot dodge, and can take one attack before disintegrating. Enemies that were attacking you will attack the skin decoy instead.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A
data.level5Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: As a Centaur, you can use your powerful horse half to jump further, trample enemies and kick them with great force.
data.level1Description: Automatically pass a Strength (Jumping) check. This cannot be done after you have rolled for the check.
data.level2Description: Kick an enemy to the ground, forcing them to make a 12+ Endurance (Impact) check. If they fail, they lose their major and minor action getting back up. If they succeed, they only lose their minor action
data.level3Description: If you move into melee with an enemy and attack them in the same time (such as when you Charge), you deal an extra D6 damage.
data.level4Description: When an enemy is at 4 Health or lower, you can instantly knock them out with a kick. They remain unconscious for two hours.
data.level5Description: You are considered mounted at all times.

data.abilityDescription: You have spent much of your life in the darkness, whether that be operating solely at night or deep underground. When in the dark, you are more focused, can see better and have even learnt to extinguish lights and travel between shadows.
data.level1Description: When fully in the darkness, you have a +2 to all checks. When fully in the light, you have -1 to all checks.
data.level2Description: Extinguish a light source within ten metres of you.
data.level3Description: You can see in the dark and suffer no Perception (Seeing) penalties due to darkness or low light.
data.level4Description: If you have stayed out of the light for at least 24 hours, then you can use one of your abilities once at any level, regardless of whether or not you have that level of that ability. Once you have used this, the 24-hour period restarts.
data.level5Description: When fully immersed in darkness, you can teleport to a shadow within line of sight, assuming the shadow is big enough to fully cover you.

data.abilityDescription: You quickly patch up a serious injury. Whilst this is not enough to do anything in the long term, it does keep your ally on their feet for a bit longer, until proper medical care can be administered.
data.level1Description: Heal an ally within melee range of you for ten Health. They lose 2 Health a turn if in combat for five rounds, or a total of 10 Health over a ten-minute period if out of combat.
data.level2Description: You can now use Stem the Bleeding as a minor action.
data.level3Description: You can now use Stem the Bleeding on yourself.
data.level4Description: A target affected by Stem the Bleeding now only loses 2 Health a turn for three rounds, or a total of 6 Health over a five-minute period if out of combat.
data.level5Description: Stem the Bleeding can increase an ally’s Health up to 6 Health above their Max Health.

data.abilityDescription: One of the most common abilities of those who wield the power of Fulgaram is the power to summon a storm. These storms can take many forms, invoking wind, rain, fog, thunder and lightning, and are always impressive.
data.level1Description: Create a storm that covers an area within one turn of you. This can be summoned indoors. You choose whether your storm has a damp chill, reducing the Dexterity of all enemies in the storm by 1, or a brisk wind, reducing their Strength by 1. The storm lasts for 30 minutes, or until the end of combat.
data.level2Description: You may now create a storm anywhere you can see.
data.level3Description: When making your storm, spend 2 extra Focus to add fog. Fog causes enemies within the storm to suffer a -3 to Perception (Seeing) checks.
data.level4Description: When making your storm, spend 2 extra Focus to add thunder. When you do this, there is an ominous rumble of thunder and all enemies must pass a 12+ Willpower (Courage) check or lose 5 Focus.
data.level5Description: When making your storm, you can add lightning at a cost of 3 Focus per lightning strike. Each lightning strike strikes an enemy, dealing 4 damage. An enemy cannot be hit by more than one lightning strike as part of a single storm.

data.abilityDescription: You manipulate the atomic structure of a material, using technology to introduce subatomic particles and electrical charges to transform that material into a different one.
data.level1Description: Transmute non-sentient, non-living solid material into another non-sentient, non-living solid material of your choice. The cost of this ability varies based on how much material you are transmuting, and what you are transmuting it into.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A
data.level5Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: Wielding a weapon in each hand, you move across the battlefield with speed, striking multiple foes at once and chipping away at distracted enemies.
data.level1Description: If you are wielding two one-handed weapons, then as a major action, you can launch an attack against two enemies within attackable range. You roll to hit separately against each enemy and deal half damage if you hit. The other levels of this ability can also only be used when wielding two one-handed weapons.
data.level2Description: Move up to two turns. This move must bring you into attackable range of an enemy.
data.level3Description: When you successfully damage an enemy with your weapon, deal D4 damage to another enemy within attackable range of you. This ability can be used as a minor action.
data.level4Description: When an ally within melee range of you is damaged, you get to make an attack against the enemy that hit them. This attack deals half damage if it hits. This does not take an action to do, but once used, cannot be used again until after your turn.
data.level5Description: Deal half your weapon damage to all enemies within melee range of you (if using melee weapons), or all enemies that are one turn away from you (if using ranged weapons).

data.abilityDescription: As a newly turned werewolf, Ashley still struggles with controlling her feral urges, especially in dangerous situations. Until she learns to control them, these instincts can sometimes even lead to her inadvertently harming her allies.
data.level1Description: When you drop to or go below zero Health, before you go down, deal  your Sharp Claw weapon damage to a random target within melee range. This ability can damage your allies.
data.level2Description: Your Feral Instincts now also trigger when you drop below half health.
data.level3Description: When your Feral Instincts triggers, it now only deals damage to a random enemy within melee range, as opposed to potentially hitting allies.
data.level4Description: When your Feral Instincts trigger due to you dropping to or below zero Health, instead of going down, you are brought up to three Health. This still counts as you going down.
data.level5Description: When your Feral Instincts trigger, instead of dealing damage, you can choose to become immune to all damage for a round.

data.abilityDescription: You let out a reassuring chant, rallying your allies and helping them to shake off any negative effects.
data.level1Description: Let out an audible chant, removing any debuffs from yourself and any allies in audible range, and giving you and all allies a +4 to Willpower (Courage) checks for 20 minutes.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A
data.level5Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: You generate and release a small scouting drone. Capable of moving almost silently, you can view a live feed from the drone, allowing you to report on enemy positions, and even use it as a remote bomb.
data.level1Description: Release a movable, flying drone at your location. The drone lasts for ten minutes and will go where you direct it. You can see whatever the drone sees through a live feed.
data.level2Description: Release a movable, flying drone at your location. The drone lasts for ten minutes and will go where you direct it. You can see whatever the drone sees through a live feed and can give it new commands through this live feed.
data.level3Description: Release a movable, flying drone at your location. The drone lasts for an hour and will go where you direct it. You can see whatever the drone sees through a live feed and can give it new commands through this live feed.
data.level4Description: You can now attach your 10-Focus drone to an enemy, preventing that enemy from attacking as long as it is attached. The drone can be removed with a 15+ Strength (Might) check (this check can be attempted once per round per individual), or with a successful attack made against it by another target. Any attacks made against the drone that miss hit the target the drone is attached to unless the attacker passes an 11+ Luck check.
data.level5Description: If a drone is attached to a target for two rounds, you can detonate the drone on your turn as a minor action, destroying the drone and dealing 2D10 damage to the target it is attached to.

data.abilityDescription: Your species are adapted to live underwater. Whilst this can manifest in a number of traits and biological features, the most common is the ability to breathe underwater.
data.level1Description: You can breathe underwater.

data.abilityDescription: You are afflicted by unclear visions, swirling masses of cloud through which you can see flickers of the past or future, and metaphorical representations of your life and destiny.
data.level1Description: At random moments, as determined by your GM, you gain a -1 Tiredness debuff (if you do not already have one) and have a vision. These visions can be any combination of the present, future or past and can contain symbolic representations or objective scenes. Your GM determines the contents of the vision and also rolls a D20 to determine how clear the vision is, with a lower result resulting in more distorted dialogue and visuals that may obscure aspects of the vision.

data.level1Description: When you leave Stealth, you keep the +7 bonus to hit until the end of your next turn.

data.abilityDescription: You are trained in negotiation and de-escalation, and can read people fairly well, intuiting what they want, and working together with them to find a compromise. You can also, if need be, start and spread damaging rumours to further your cause.
data.level1Description: After talking with someone for at least one minute, spend 3 Focus to know which Charisma specialty will be most effective when trying to get them to do a specific thing, and which specialty will be least effective.
data.level2Description: When you first come into contact with a civilisation or group, spend 10 Focus to know someone within that civilisation or group, assuming it is feasible for you to have visited that group in the past.
data.level3Description: When trying to negotiate with someone, determine what an individual wants most from the negotiations.
data.level4Description: When you are talking with aggressive people, or in a situation where there is a risk of combat, know whether it is possible to resolve things without combat.
data.level5Description: Make a Charisma (Deception) check to spread a rumour of your choice amongst the people you are with over the course of six hours. How far the rumour spreads and how many people believe it depends on how much Focus you spend, how high your Deception check result is and how believable the rumour is.

data.abilityDescription: Bright blue tattoos adorn your body, created with incredible care by Shinjuku artisans. At a touch, these tattoos can discharge electricity, increasing your speed and disabling electrical systems.
data.level1Description: Charge your body with electricity, giving yourself a +3 modifier to a DEX check. This takes a minor action to use in combat.
data.level2Description: When you successfully hit an enemy, you can charge the attack with electricity, causing it to deal an additional 3 damage. This takes a minor action.
data.level3Description: Touch an unprotected electronic system and emit a small EMP, disabling the system for a minute.
data.level4Description: When an enemy in melee range of you is reduced to 0 Health or below, you can spend 4 Focus to knock them out instead of killing them without needing to make a Strength (Control) check. You can do this to an enemy regardless of who reduced their Health, and this doesn’t take an action to do.
data.level5Description: When using Levels 1-3 of this ability, you can boost yourself with extra electricity, dealing 1+D6 damage to yourself, but doubling the DEX boost/damage dealt/duration an unprotected system remains disabled.

data.abilityDescription: Enemies that try to close in on you find themselves unable to as you retreat and pepper them with shots, whether alone or as part of a squad.
data.level1Description: You can now Fall Back up to two turns away from your target, suffering no penalty to hit when you attack as part of your Fall Back Manoeuvre.
data.level2Description: Fall Back no longer has a Focus cost.
data.level3Description: You can now Fall Back for full damage.
data.level4Description: When combat begins, you can spend 3 Focus to Fall Back from an enemy, putting yourself first in the turn order and using up your major action. You cannot do this if you were surprised.
data.level5Description: When you Fall back from an enemy, you can bring any willing allies within melee range of you with you, at a cost of 3 Focus per ally. Each ally deals D3 damage to the target of your Fall Back, regardless of whether or not your Fall Back hits.

data.abilityDescription: You have spent your life shunning planet life, instead living aboard ships and stations. You are now at home on them and can even tell when something is wrong by minute changes in the hum and vibration of the deck.
data.level1Description: When on a spaceship or space station, you have a +2 to all Strength, Endurance and Dexterity checks. When on a planet or asteroid, you have a -1 to all Strength, Endurance and Dexterity checks.
data.level2Description: You are attuned to the needs of your crewmates, and instantly pass Perception (Empathy) checks when judging the emotional state of your fellow crew.
data.level3Description: You have a +2 to your Mindset when sleeping on a spaceship or space station. This cannot raise your Mindset above a 5.
data.level4Description: In each planet or space station you visit, you know someone. When you first visit that location, roll a D20 to see how useful this person is, with a higher check result being a more useful contact.
data.level5Description: When on a spaceship or space station, if something goes wrong with the systems, you are aware of it.

data.abilityDescription: You have a trusty mount, whether it be a horse, motorbike or other, stranger method of transformation. This mount is very advantageous, allowing you to move quicker and chase down targets.
data.level1Description: You have a mount. This mount can be a living creature of a vehicle, and what exactly your mount is should be discussed with your GM before the start of the adventure. Your mount has 12 Health. Whenever you are successfully attacked, the attacker can choose to damage your mount instead of you. If your mount reaches zero Health, then you are dismounted, and the mount cannot be used until the end of combat.
