data.level2Description: Give yourself a +2 to any check. This can be done after rolling for the check. This can’t be used multiple times for the same check.
data.level3Description: All combat manoeuvres you attempt cost 1 less Focus.
data.level4Description: When you draw on a roll against an enemy, you win instead of having to reroll.
data.level5Description: You are skilled with all weapon groups.

data.level1Description: Transfer any amount of your Focus to an ally within one turn. This cannot increase their Focus above its maximum. This can be done at any time and does not take an action to do.

data.abilityDescription: Rather than focusing on one enemy at a time, your attacks hit multiple enemies at once as you dart around the battlefield.
data.level1Description: When combat begins, if you are wielding a ranged weapon, you can launch a weapon attack against an enemy within attackable range. This does not take an action and does not affect the turn order. The other levels of this ability can also only be used when wielding a ranged weapon.
data.level2Description: When you attack an enemy, you can spend 3 Focus to attack another enemy within attackable range, with all enemies rolling to dodge against the same Strength (Attacking) check. This must be done before you roll to hit, and can be used to hit up to ten enemies, at a cost of 3 Focus per additional enemy. This ability can be used as a minor action.
data.level3Description: When you Fall Back, you now also attack up to two additional enemies within melee range of your original target. All enemies roll Dexterity (Dodging) against the same Strength (Attacking) check.
data.level4Description: When multiple enemies make Dexterity (Dodging) checks against a single Strength (Attacking) check you have made, you can spend 4 Focus to reroll your Strength (Attacking) check. This can be done multiple times and must be done before the enemies roll to dodge. This does not take an action to do.
data.level5Description: If you hit at least four enemies in a single turn with attacks, you can move up to one turn without using an action.

data.abilityDescription: Whilst others operate on the front lines, you stay back, acting through robotic duplicates. As your technological skill grows, these proxies become more and more competent, with you eventually able to act alongside your proxies, being in multiple places at once.
data.level1Description: Create and operate a robotic proxy that you control from your current location. The robot is identical in appearance to you, but has no stat modifiers and 1 Health. Whilst controlling your robotic proxy, you cannot perform any other actions.
data.level2Description: Your robotic proxy now has 5 Health and has the same stats and Max Focus as you.
data.level3Description: You can now perform actions and act normally whilst controlling your robotic proxy, although you have a -2 to all checks due to the strain of controlling your proxy.
data.level4Description: Your robotic proxy now has 10 Health and has the same abilities as you (with the exception of this ability).
data.level5Description:
You now create and control two robotic proxies at once
OR
You can teleport to your robotic proxy, appearing next to it. This destroys the proxy.

data.abilityDescription: Many gremlins have an aptitude for technology. However, where most gremlins use this for sabotage, cutting wires and disabling vehicles, Vex uses it to create a number of helpful, albeit short-lived, items and gadgets that can be used to aid him and his allies.
data.level1Description: Create a small, mechanical light that hovers just above the ground and lights up the area in all directions around it to the same degree an ordinary torch would. The light lasts for 2 hours after it was created, at which point it breaks.
data.level2Description: Create a Health Equaliser that you can hook up to two willing allies, including yourself. The two allies Health is combined and then split evenly between the two of them. The Health Equaliser must be used immediately after being created, does not take an action to use, and breaks after one use.
data.level3Description: Create a 3 metre, extendable ladder, that can be used to access previously inaccessible areas and climb without requiring a check. The ladder breaks 15 minutes after being created.
data.level4Description: Create and fire a small sound cannon at an enemy. The enemy must make a 12+ Endurance (Impact) check. If they fail then they lose their next major action. If they succeed then they lose their next minor action. The sound cannon breaks after being used.
data.level5Description: Create a forcefield with X Health at your location. When any allies within melee range of the forcefield takes damage, the forcefield takes the damage instead. The forcefield cannot be healed and when it hits zero Health, or the combat encounter ends, the forcefield is destroyed.

data.abilityDescription: You can see an aura of coloured energy around anything magical, or any use of magic, and can even determine the type of magic by its colour, and how powerful it is.
data.level1Description: You can see an aura around anything magical, including colour of the magic used and how strong it is, for one minute. You cannot move whilst your Magical Vision is active.
data.level2Description: You can now move whilst your Magical Vision is active.
data.level3Description: Your Magical Vision now lasts for ten minutes.
data.level4Description: When activating your Magical Vision, you can spend an extra 2 Focus to see auras of magic even through a surface, although you cannot see them if they are behind multiple surfaces.
data.level5Description: Your Magical Vision is now always active as a permanent passive effect. Level 4 of this ability is now activated independently to allow you to see auras of magic through a single surface for ten minutes.

data.abilityDescription: You wield two giant cannons. Utilising advanced technology and infused with fae magic, your right cannon deals devastating damage, whilst your left inflicts a variety of debilitating effects, clouding your enemies' minds and making them fall in love with you.
data.level1Description: You have two energy cannons; a Right Cannon and a Left Cannon. Each turn, you can attack once with each cannon, or twice with one of your cannons. Your Right Cannon deals D6 Blasting damage (Ranged only), and your Left Cannon deals D4 Wounding Damage (Ranged only) and reduces the enemy’s Focus by D4 when they are hit.
data.level2Description:
When you attack with your Right Cannon, you can spend 3 Focus to change the damage type to a type of your choosing.
When you attack with your Left Cannon, you can spend 3 Focus to cloud your enemy’s mind, causing them to lose their Minor action unless they pass a 14+ Willpower (Self-Discipline) check.
This does not take an action to do.
data.level3Description: Your Right Cannon now deals D8 damage and ignores armour, whilst your Left Cannon now deals D6 damage and reduces the enemy’s Focus by 2+D4.
data.level4Description: When you attack with your Right Cannon, you can spend 5 Focus to instead fire an explosive blast that automatically hits, deals D6 damage to the target, and hits all enemies within melee range of the target for half damage. When you attack with your Left Cannon, you can instead fire an Infatuation blast that deals no damage, automatically hits, and forces the enemy to make a 19+ Willpower (Resistance) check. This is reduced to 15+ if the enemy is not attracted to your gender. If they fail, they fall in love with you and will do their best to protect you from harm and fulfill your wants. The target repeats the Willpower Resistance check every round until the end of combat, or until they pass, at which point the effect ends. This does not take an action to do.
data.level5Description:
If your final check result is a 20 or above when attacking with the Right Cannon, treat the attack as a critical hit.
When any enemy has to make a check to resist any of the effects of your Left Cannon, spend 4 Focus to make them automatically fail.

data.level1Description: Drain the Health of an enemy in melee range, dealing D4 damage and restoring that much Focus.
data.level2Description: You can now use Drain Life on an ally.
data.level3Description: Drain the life from everything in melee range of you, dealing D4 damage to all targets in melee range of you and restoring Focus equal to the total amount drained. This deals 3 damage to you for each target affected.
data.level4Description: Drain the remaining dregs of life from a corpse that has died within the last hour, restoring 2 Focus. You can only use this once per corpse.
data.level5Description: When using Drain Life, you can now choose to restore no Focus, and instead deal double damage. This must be done before rolling for damage.

data.abilityDescription: Having trained her whole life as part of the Doedicurus Clan, Urodela is incredibly strong, and has learnt to use her armour to its full effect.
data.level1Description: Gain +5 to a Charisma (Intimidation) check. This can be done after rolling for the check.
data.level2Description: If you go down and are revived, your Health is brought up to 5 (assuming you were not healed above 5 Health when revived).
data.level3Description: You gain a +4 to your Dexterity (Initiative) check when rolling to prevent someone from disarming you.
data.level4Description: Your armour now blocks all damage equally, regardless of armour type and is not affected by attacks that ignore armour.
data.level5Description: Once per two fights you can negate one attack made against you.

data.abilityDescription: You infect a piece of technology with a custom virus, taking over the system and transferring control to you. However, different technologies will have different security measures, with some beyond your ability to control.
data.level1Description: You zap a piece of technology with a virus, allowing you to control it. Each piece of technology will have a rating between 1 and 30, as determined by your GM, with 1 being a small unprotected system, and 30 being a massive, heavily protected system. You must match or beat the technology’s rating with an Intelligence (Computing) check to successfully control it. The technology cannot do anything beyond what it could before, but its capabilities can be directed in ways they previously couldn’t (e.g. a turret which previously targeted randomly can now be directed against specific targets). Your GM may exclude technology which it would not be feasible for you to control from this ability.

data.abilityDescription: Your sense of smell is highly developed, and you tend to rely on it over your other senses. This has also given you a natural advantage when tracking people down, be they enemies or allies.
data.level1Description: When you have to make a Perception (Tracking) check, make a Perception (Smelling) check instead.
data.level2Description: Learn rough information about where someone has been for the last two hours, assuming you are close enough to smell them.
data.level3Description: When asked to make a Perception (Seeing) or (Hearing) check in response to an enemy’s Dexterity (Stealth) check, you can make a Perception (Smelling) check instead.
data.level4Description: When you are in proximity to someone, or an object that would spend a lot of time with, gain that person’s scent. For the next four days, you will know if that person has been in your current location anytime within the last week.
data.level5Description: Remember the smell of someone you have spent at least 24 hours with. You can track that person to their current location without needing to make a check, assuming they are not behind an airtight barrier or have passed through a vacuum, at which point you track them until that point. You can have up to three people’s smells remembered in this way.

data.abilityDescription:
In combat, you do not strike out at your enemies as your allies do. Instead, you advise and inspire from the back, directing the flow of battle and using careful planning to get the most out of your fellow fighters.
(This ability has additional supporting information)
data.level1Description: When combat begins, you enter Advisor Mode. In Advisor Mode you do not have a major or minor action. Instead, you have three advisor actions a turn, which you can use to provide various benefits to your party (these are provided in the supporting text). You can end Advisor Mode in combat for no action but cannot re-enter it that combat.
data.level2Description: You now have five Advisor Actions a turn.
data.level3Description: Twice per combat encounter, you can have an effect (that costs advisor actions) that normally affects a single ally affect all allies.
data.level4Description: You now have 8 Advisor Actions a turn.
data.level5Description: Twice per combat encounter, you can have an effect (that costs advisor actions) last until the end of combat, instead of for a round. This cannot be done at the same time as Level 3 of this ability.

data.abilityDescription: Mirid travels with his trusty badger companion Brusk. A steadfast and loyal friend, Brusk is quite durable, and is an expert at sniffing out rare items and gold.
data.level1Description: You have a normal-sized badger that can be used out of combat for a variety of uses. Your badger has 10 Health, +1 STR and +2 END (Its endurance modifier is already added to his Health). If your badger loses all his Health it is not killed, but must recover for 6 hours before it can be used again.
data.level2Description: When entering or in combat, you can spend 4 Focus to have your badger take part in the battle. Your badger has Slashing D4 Claws. If your badger loses all of its Health in combat, it can be used again after only 3 hours.
data.level3Description: Your badger can instantly pass a Perception (Searching) check.
data.level4Description: Your badger gains +1 STR, +1 PER and +1 Natural armour.
data.level5Description: Restore your badger to full health. If your badger has lost all its Health and is recovering, using this ability allows it to be used again immediately.This ability can’t be used whilst in combat.

data.abilityDescription: You unleash a powerful blast of Shadowlight that engulfs everything around you, healing allies and dissolving enemies, although how much of the blast is shadow, and how much is light is outside of your control.
data.level1Description: Roll a D4. Whatever you roll, restore double that much Health to all allies within melee range of you, and deal double the difference between your roll and 4 to all enemies within melee range of you as damage.
data.level2Description: This ability now affects all allies and enemies within one turn of you.
data.level3Description: When you roll for this ability, you can increase your roll by 1 if you are in the light or decrease your roll by 1 if you are in the darkness. This cannot reduce the dice result below its minimum number or increase it above its maximum number.
data.level4Description: Roll a D4. Whatever you roll, restore triple that much Health to all allies within one turn of you, and deal triple the difference between your roll and 4 to all enemies as damage.
data.level5Description: When you roll for this ability, if your final result is the minimum result (1), the damage you deal ignores armour. If your final result is the maximum amount (4), all allies healed also restores D8 Focus. If your final result is in the middle (2 or 3), you restore 5 Focus.

data.abilityDescription: Your body dissolves into a shadowy form that slinks around silently and with unnatural agility. When in this form, you can slip through small gaps, although bright light is harmful to you.
data.level1Description: Transform your body into a shadowy form for three seconds, allowing you to slip through any non-airtight gap. Whilst in this shadow form, you cannot enter light.
data.level2Description: Transform your body into a shadowy form for three seconds, allowing you to slip through any non-airtight gap. Whilst in this shadow form, entering light causes you to take 1/3 of your Max Health in damage.
data.level3Description:
Transform your body into a shadowy form, allowing you to slip through any non-airtight gap. Whilst in this shadow form, entering light causes you to take 1/3 of your Max Health in damage. You can end Shadow Form at any time as a minor action.
Whilst in shadow form, you have +2 DEX and -2 STR, and always have a minimum final result of 16 on any Stealth checks.
data.level4Description:
Transform your body into a shadowy form, allowing you to slip through any non-airtight gap. Whilst in this shadow form, entering light causes you to take 1/3 of your Max Health in damage. You can end Shadow Form at any time as a minor action.
Whilst in shadow form, you have +2 DEX, -2 STR and take 2 less damage from all attacks, and always have a minimum final result of 16 on any Stealth checks.
data.level5Description:
Transform your body into a shadowy form, allowing you to slip through any non-airtight gap. You can end Shadow Form at any time as a minor action.
Whilst in shadow form, you have +2 DEX, -2 STR and take 2 less damage from all attacks, and always have a minimum final result of 16 on any Stealth checks.

data.abilityDescription: You are incredibly agile, able to react quickly to attacks, scale buildings, leap great distances and move at great speed.
data.level1Description: When you need to make a Strength (Climbing) or (Jumping) check, make a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check instead.
data.level2Description: When you take damage as a result of falling, spend 1 Focus to half it.
data.level3Description: When you make a Dexterity (Dodging) check in response to being attacked, you can spend 4 Focus to roll two dice and take the higher result. If you still fail the check, you take 50% more damage from the attack. You must choose to do this before rolling to dodge but can choose to do this after you opponent makes their Strength (Attacking) check. This doesn’t take an action to do.
data.level4Description: When you are about to attack, you can make a Dexterity (Precision) check instead of a Strength (Attacking) check. This does not take an action to do (although the attack itself still takes a major action).
data.level5Description: Move one turn. This can be used as a minor action.

data.abilityDescription: You are skilled in fighting against Animists, being able to assess their capabilities quickly, take advantage of gaps in their defence and even use a black-market potion to temporarily strip them of their abilities.
data.level1Description: When looking at something with essence imbued into it, you can tell what up to three of those essences are, assuming it is of something you would be aware of.
data.level2Description: When you have to make a check that is the result of an essence-based effect, increase the check result by X, up to a +5. This does not take an action to do.
data.level3Description: When looking at something with essence imbued into it, pick one of the essences imbued into it and learn any effects or abilities related to that essence. This can only be done once per target.
data.level4Description: When a target within attackable range uses an animist-based ability or one that is the result of essence imbuation, launch an attack against them. This does not take an action to do.
data.level5Description: Fire a projectile laced with a black-market potion at a target with essence imbued into it, disabling any essence-based effects or animist abilities for one round.

data.abilityDescription: You draw souls from those who worship you, commanding a cult of dedicated followers who you can command and manipulate.
data.level1Description: You can obtain someone’s soul if they see you as a deity or worship you. You gain 1 Soul every 3 days per worshipper, assuming the target continues to view you as a figure of worship and performs acts of active worship totalling at least one hour across the 3-day period. You can use up 1 Soul to increase the result of a check by 3, heal for 6 health or restore 9 Focus. Using a soul in this way is a minor action.
data.level2Description:
See through the eyes of someone who has given you their soul for fifteen minutes. During this time you can mentally communicate with them.
You can also now spend 3 Souls to gain an Overcharge as a minor action.
data.level3Description: Give a command of up to three words to any targets that can hear you and are worshipping you. The targets will do their best to carry out the command for the next hour, or until the command has been fulfilled. The targets cannot be commanded to do something that would directly harm them or those they hold dear. There is no penalty if the targets fails to carry out the command.
data.level4Description: If a target has been worshipping you for at least two weeks, Level 3 of this ability can now be used to make the target carry out a command that would directly harm them or those they hold dear.
data.level5Description: If you are about to take damage that would down or kill you, you can magically redirect the harm to someone who is worshipping you, regardless of how far away they are, killing them and negating the damage. This uses up your next major action.

data.abilityDescription: You are a capable and reliable fighter, using your shield to draw fire from enemies, protect your allies and deal reliable, accurate strikes against your enemies.
data.level1Description: If you are wielding a single one-handed melee weapon and a shield, you can give yourself a -3 to Dexterity (Dodging) in order to gain a +3 to Strength (Attacking), or vice versa. This does not take an action to do. Once this has been used, it cannot be used again until your next turn and this must be used before you attack that turn. The other levels of this ability can also only be used when wielding a single, one-handed melee weapon and a shield.
data.level2Description: When you successfully attack an enemy within melee range, an ally within melee range of you can move one turn immediately. This does not take an action for you or the ally.
data.level3Description: If an ally is about to attacked by an enemy, you can instead force the enemy to have a 50% chance of attacking you instead, assuming you are within attackable range. This does not take an action to do and must be done before the enemy rolls to hit.
data.level4Description: When an attack or damaging ability is successfully made against an ally within melee range of you, you can negate it. This can be done after the enemy rolls for damage. However, the next attack made against you automatically hits, and deals 1 extra damage. Once you have used this, you cannot use it again until an attack has been made against you.
data.level5Description: When you successfully hit an enemy, instead of rolling for damage, you can choose to instead deal your weapon’s average damage, rounding up. This must be done before rolling for damage and does not take an action to do.

data.abilityDescription: Whilst the majority of the Cabre fleshsmithing uses specialised equipment and tools, a Cabre can, in an emergency, use flesh taken directly from a body to patch themselves up, although the quality of the flesh varies.
data.level1Description: When standing next to a dead body, you can spend your minor action to take its flesh and incorporate it into your own body, healing yourself for 1+D4.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A
data.level5Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription:
A blessing by the Great Beast Carranosauran Rex has given you a Carannosaurn pet that is bonded to you. The pet is very strong and powerful and can develop in a myriad of ways.
(This ability has additional supporting information)
data.level1Description:
You have a Carranosaurn cub. The cub has 20 Health, 16 Focus and a 2D6 Crushing Bite attack. If your Cub is killed, it must recover for 6 hours before it can do anything. Choose one of the following ways to develop your Cub:
Reflexes
Bulk
Ferocity
data.level2Description:
Choose one of the following ways to develop your Cub:
Savagery
Heft
Mount
data.level3Description:
Your Cub now has 22 Focus. In addition, choose one of the following ways to develop your Cub:
Prowl
Critical
Temperament
data.level4Description:
Your cub gains +3 stat points, to be distributed as you wish. You also choose one of the following ways to develop your Cub:
Speed
Threatening
Charm
data.level5Description:
Your Cub now has 28 Focus. In addition, choose two of the following ways to develop your Cub:
Pack Leader
Pack Mule
Senses
Mental Link
Carapace
You can also take any previous ways of developing your Carranosaurn that you did not previously take in place of any of these options.

data.abilityDescription: You fire a beam of energy which sucks away the life of your target. As your prowess grows, this life can be repurposed and infused into you and your allies, healing their wounds.
data.level1Description: You fire a beam of energy at an enemy up to two turns away, dealing D6 damage to them. You must roll to hit with this attack.
data.level2Description: You fire a beam of energy at an enemy up to two turns away, dealing D6 damage to them.
data.level3Description: You fire a beam of energy at an enemy up to two turns away, dealing 2+D8 damage to them.
data.level4Description: You fire a beam of energy at an enemy up to two turns away, dealing 2+D8 damage to them and healing you for the same amount.
data.level5Description: You fire a beam of energy at an enemy up to two turns away, dealing 2+D8 damage to them and healing you and all allies in melee range of you for the same amount.

data.abilityDescription: Durable and well-built, you are an imposing sight, capable of surviving fatal blows and using your armour to its full effect.
data.level1Description: Gain +5 to a Charisma (Intimidation) check. This can be done after rolling for the check.
data.level2Description: If you go down and are revived, your Health is brought up to 5 (assuming you were not healed above 5 Health when revived).
data.level3Description: You gain a +4 to your Dexterity (Initiative) check when rolling to prevent someone from disarming you.
data.level4Description: Your armour now blocks all damage equally, regardless of armour type and is not affected by attacks that ignore armour.
data.level5Description: Once per two fights you can negate one attack made against you.

data.abilityDescription: You have spent much of your time exploring underground areas, giving you an innate sense of direction and a level of comfort when underground.
data.level1Description: You can see in the dark and suffer no Perception penalties due to low light or darkness.
data.level2Description: When underground, gain a D4 bonus to all checks. This is upgraded to 2D4 after spending 24 hours underground consecutively, and 3D4 after 48 hours.
data.level3Description: Identify an underground species you can see, giving you a description of the species, as well as two helpful pieces of information about it. This cannot be used on unique creatures or beings.
data.level4Description: When underground, deduce the rough direction to go deeper underground, as well as the rough direction of a route back to the surface.
data.level5Description: Level 2 of this ability now starts at a 2D4 bonus to all checks when underground, increasing by 2D4 for every 24 hours spent underground to a maximum of 8D4 after 3 days. This bonus lasts for an hour after returning to the surface, assuming you have spent at least an hour underground.

data.abilityDescription: You run at a target and unleash a powerful attack. This makes a good opener in battle and can often take your foe by surprise.
data.level1Description: You charge towards an enemy up to one turn away, moving to their position and attacking them. This can be used at the start of combat and will put you first in the turn order, using up your major action. You cannot do this if you were surprised.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A
data.level5Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: You transform into a hulking werewolf berserker, glowing with searing light and wielding long, curved claws that can slice through armour and flesh alike.
data.level1Description: Transform into your Alfheðinn form, gaining 3 Natural Armour, +8 Endurance (therefore giving you 16 Max Health) and healing yourself to full health. You can see in the dark, suffering no perception penalties due to darkness. Once you have transformed, you cannot change back until the combat is over.
data.level2Description: Your Alfheðinn form now costs 19 Focus, but when in your Alfheðinn form, your claws are imbued with the power of searing light, giving you a Light-Imbued Slash attack that deals 3D6 damage (melee only).
data.level3Description: Your Alfheðinn form now costs 25 Focus, but when in it, you now have a +5 to your Strength (Control) check when attempting to grapple. When you successfully grapple an enemy in your Alfheðinn form, you deal 4+D10 damage to them as searing light burns them.
data.level4Description: When you are reduced to zero health, you can use your Alfheðinn Transformation ability even if it is not your turn and even if you have used your major action that turn, assuming you have not transformed already.
data.level5Description: Your Alfheðinn form now costs 30 Focus but gives you all the bonuses of the previous levels, plus +6 Strength, and the ability to use your Light-Imbued Claws against a target at range, firing off a beam of light against them (this deals the same damage as the attack in melee).

data.abilityDescription: In battles between spaceships, you are able to push your ship to its fullest, redirecting power to boost systems, perform short FTL jumps and manipulate the electromagnetic fields around the ship.
data.level1Description: You can damage one of your ships systems to instantly gain 10 Fuel. This does not take an action to do.
data.level2Description: Order your ship to perform a short, quick FTL jump, leaving behind an afterimage. This means your opponent has a 50% chance to believe the afterimage is your ship and target it instead. This ability cannot be used two rounds in a row, and uses up your vehicle’s minor action.
data.level3Description: You can draw power from any ship system, with that system being treated as damaged, and channel it into another system, repairing the system if it is damaged or overcharging it if it is already repaired (what form this overcharging takes is to be discussed between you and the GM). This lasts for one round and any effects of this ability end after the power draw ends. This does not take an action to do.
data.level4Description: Channel an EMP through your engines, sending out a pulse that destroys your Engine system and disables any nearby enemy ship for one round, preventing them from carrying out any action. This ability can be extended for an extra 5 Fuel a round without taking up an action. When this effect ends, your Engine system goes from destroyed to damaged.
data.level5Description: Magnetise your hull, drawing any metal objects towards you. The cost of this ability will depend on what is being drawn towards you, and for how long.

data.abilityDescription: Ironhide has spent years fighting almost every kind of foe imaginable. He is a master of combat, and although his own fighting ability is reduced, he can pass his knowledge on to his allies.
data.level1Description: Select an enemy. You and your allies gain a +2 to hit against that enemy for a round. When this ability expires, it can be extended by a round for 2 Focus. This doesn’t take up an action and can be used over multiple rounds. This ability can only be used on one enemy at a time.
data.level2Description: When you or an ally roll a natural 19 on your Strength (Attacking) check, you can spend 4 Focus to make it a critical hit (assuming you/they pass the roll).
data.level3Description: Once per fight, you can make a combat manoeuvre you or an ally perform cost no Focus.
data.level4Description: When combat begins, you can spend 3 Focus to pick an ally. That ally automatically goes first in the turn order. Everyone else rolls Initiative as usual. You cannot use this ability to go first yourself.
data.level5Description: When you deal the final blow to an enemy, you can automatically knock them out without having to make a Strength (Control) check, regardless of what weapon you are using.

data.abilityDescription: Sarsha can unleash a powerful shot from her sniper rifle that can blow foes apart and punch through the heaviest of armour.
data.level1Description: Fire a high-powered shot, dealing 5+1D5 damage. You must roll to hit when using this ability. This ability only costs 3 Focus if it misses.
data.level2Description: Fire a high-powered shot, dealing 5+1D5 damage. This attack can’t miss.
data.level3Description: Your High-Powered Shot now ignores 1 armour.
data.level4Description: Your High-Powered Shot now ignores all armour.
data.level5Description: You can now fire off up to three high-powered shots as one major action, at a cost of 10 Focus per shot.

data.abilityDescription: You blend into a nearby shadow, remaining perfectly still as enemies pass by, allowing to remain undetected.
data.level1Description: Hide in a shadow big enough to conceal you, giving you a +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks as long as you remain in the shadow and are not moving when looked at.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A
data.level5Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: You have a stock of mines, designed to explode when a target steps on it. The explosion of these mines is very damaging, and allies can potentially be caught in the blast.
data.level1Description: Place down an explosive mine at your position that detonates when a target (excluding you) is within melee range of it. When the mine detonates, it deals 5 damage to all targets within melee range of itself.
data.level2Description: You can now remotely detonate your mine, even if no target has come within melee range of it. This does not take an action to do.
data.level3Description: When a target enters melee range of your mine, you can now remotely prevent it from detonating. This does not take an action to do.
data.level4Description: Your mines can now deal non-lethal damage, knocking out any enemies that it reduces to zero Health, instead of killing them.
data.level5Description: Place down a heavy explosive mine at your position that detonates when a target (excluding you) is within melee range of it. When the mine detonates, it deals 9 damage to all targets within one turn of itself.

data.abilityDescription: You throw down an advanced device that manipulates the magnetic movement of atoms around it, creating a powerful magnetic field. This can later be used to manipulate the atoms of an entire surface, making it magnetic.
data.level1Description: Attract a metal object towards you. This cannot be used to attract anything bigger or heavier than an average person.
data.level2Description: You can now use Level 1 of this ability to repel a metal object away from you.
data.level3Description: You can now more precisely move metal objects, being able to move them left, right, up or down.
data.level4Description: Throw a magnetic field manipulator onto a surface. At a time of your choosing, you can activate the device to draw and stick all metal objects to that surface, or push away all metal objects near it, although heavier or larger objects will be moved less.
data.level5Description: Just before you use Level 4 of this ability, you can selectively choose metal objects to be unaffected by the manipulator. These must be specific objects, and any new objects that enter the area will be affected by the manipulator.

data.abilityDescription: You are capable of creating or releasing a healing liquid, whether it is magically infused healing waters, or a cocktail of potent medical chemicals.
data.level1Description: Create a pool of healing liquid at a location within two turns of you. You and any allies heal for D4 on your turn whilst in melee range of the healing liquid. The healing liquid lasts for 4 rounds, after which it loses its potency.
data.level2Description: Use a drop of healing liquid to heal yourself or an ally for 1 health. This ability does not take an action to do and can be used anytime, whether or not it is your turn.
data.level3Description: You can now move your pool of healing liquid to any location within two turns of you. This takes a minor action to do.
data.level4Description: Spray a downed ally with healing liquid, bringing them back up to 1 Health. This can be used immediately after an ally goes down, taking up your next major action, but still counts as the ally being downed when considering how many times someone has been down.
data.level5Description: An explosion of healing liquid bursts from you. This can heal a total amount equal to half of your level. You can determine how that healing is split amongst all targets within two turns of you, including yourself.

data.abilityDescription: You dice back from a nearby enemy, throwing down razor sharp caltrops that cut your opponent as they try to follow you.
data.level1Description: Move one turn away from an enemy you are in melee range of, throwing down small caltrops as you do. If that enemy wishes to enter melee with you on their turn, they must make a 14+ Willpower (Pain) check. If they pass, they take D4 damage. If they fail, they take D4 damage and cannot move into melee with you or charge you.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A
data.level5Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: In the mountains of Kuldberg, you found an Ice Bat egg, and took it to raise. Whilst normally aggressive, training the beast since its birth has given you a strong bond with it.
data.level1Description: You have an Ice Bat. Your Ice bat has 7 Health, 12 Focus, +1 Perception and +2 Dexterity.
data.level2Description: Your Ice Bat gains +1 Dexterity, +1 Perception and +1 Strength. You can also now understand your ice Bat’s body language well enough to use it to scout for you, learning roughly what it has seen.
data.level3Description: Your Ice Bat can now be used in combat and has a D6 Ice Bolt attack (Ranged only).
data.level4Description:
Your Ice Bat gains the ‘Drain Heat’ Ability

Drain Heat- 3 Focus- Drain warmth from a target, dealing 2 damage, healing for 1 Health and gaining 1 Warmth charge. You can have a maximum of three Warmth charges at one time.
data.level5Description: When your Ice Bat has 3 Warmth charges, its next attack is a 3D4 Fire bolt  and automatically hits. This resets your Warmth charges.

data.abilityDescription: Harriet has become adept at blending in with people, concocting elaborate lies, manipulating people and using every tool at her disposal to its maximum effect.
data.level1Description: You gain +2 to Charisma checks when assuming a false identity.
data.level2Description: You gain a Puncturing D3 Concealed Dagger. This dagger can be hidden on your person and concealed through most searches.
data.level3Description: Choose one of the two following options. You get a +2 Charisma bonus when interacting with them. Higher class people in positions of leadership or power OR Lower class people who struggle to get by.
data.level4Description: You have a photographic memory, and don’t need to roll Willpower (Memory) checks to remember information.
data.level5Description: You can spend ten minutes to create a falsified or slightly edited copy of any document you are holding. The copy is very high quality, but can be detected by a skilled eye.

data.abilityDescription: You do best in risky and/or life-threatening situations, pushing yourself in risky situations and performing great feats when at risk of death.
data.level1Description: When you fail a check, you can undertake a riskier action to attempt to succeed, allowing you to reroll the check. However, if you fail this second check, it is a critical fail. This ability does not take an action to do.
data.level2Description: When you and your allies are outnumbered by your enemies, you have a +2 to Strength (Attacking) checks.
data.level3Description: When attempting First Aid on a downed ally, you have a +3 to your Intelligence (Anatomy) check and heal for an additional 2 Health.
data.level4Description: When your current Health is 10% or below of your Max Health, you can use an ability for no Focus cost. This can only be done once per combat.
data.level5Description: If it is possible for an enemy to down or kill you in a single hit, you can spend 6 Focus to turn any hit into a critical hit. This can be done after rolling to hit but must be done before rolling for damage. This does not take an action to do.

data.abilityDescription: As a rare Talbotan Werewolf, Lawrence can transform back into a human, retracting his fur and claws, and making himself more presentable to people, although it does take a great deal of concentration.
data.level1Description: Transform into your human form for an hour. Whilst in Human form, you gain +3 Charisma, but lose 2 Willpower. You can end this ability at any time for no cost. Ending this ability doesn’t take up an action.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A
data.level5Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: Due to the restrictions of her race, Sarsha is forced to use a floating chair that folds out from a small backpack in order to move quickly, although she is capable of walking using her own two legs when she needs to.
data.level1Description: When you need to make an Endurance (Running) check, you can spend 4 Focus to fold out your floating chair, allowing you to make a Dexterity (Piloting) check instead. Using this ability doesn’t require an action.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A
data.level5Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: You have a temper, and whilst you are sometimes able to control it, eventually you will snap, verbally and sometimes even physically assaulting the target of your anger. As you grow, you may better learn to control this rage, or give into it more easily.
data.level1Description: Whenever you get angry, you add a D6 (if angry) or D8 (if very angry) to a Rage Pool. You also roll all the dice in your Rage Pool and subtract your Willpower (Self-Discipline) modifier. If your final result is below 14, then nothing happens. If your final result is a 14 or above, then all dice are removed from your rage pool and you must express your rage in some form. If your final result was a 20 or above, you must attack the target of your rage. When you express your rage, you gain +4 Strength for half an hour, as long as you remain angry.
data.level2Description:
When expressing your rage, all of your attacks deal 2 more damage.
OR
When expressing your rage, you take 2 less damage from all attacks.
data.level3Description:
Instead of a D6 and a D8, the dice added to your Rage Pool are now a D4 (if angry) or a D6 (if very angry).
OR
Instead of a D6 and a D8, the dice added to your Rage Pool are now a D8 (if angry) or a D10 (if very angry).
data.level4Description:
When a dice is about to be added to your Rage Pool, you can spend 6 Focus to not add it.
OR
When dice are about to be removed from your Rage Pool, you can choose to keep dice in your Pool, at a cost of 6 Focus per dice.
data.level5Description: Express your rage early, assuming you have at least one dice in your Rage Pool.

data.abilityDescription: You are in possession of a device that creates a small pocket dimension. Items can be carefully placed into the pocket dimension, allowing them to be hidden and later retrieved. This can be useful in sneaking items into places you normally couldn’t or placing items beyond the reach of your foes.
data.level1Description: You can choose up to three items and hide them in a small pocket realm. Hiding an item in your pocket realm takes 2 hours. Once in your pocket realm, these items cannot be found on your person, and you can materialize any of these items into your hands, or onto the ground in front of you, at will.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A
data.level5Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: The Malharas are blessed with a unique ability; to take on the traits and powers of any species around them. Whilst this does not give them the skill of the original target, it can make them a powerful force to be reckoned with.
data.level1Description: You have the abilities of anyone within line of sight of you, assuming those abilities are inherent to that species. These abilities cannot be used at a level beyond that of the target you are copying it from and costs the same as it would if used by the original target. You can also take on the appearance of any species within line of sight of you, although you no not take on the exact appearance of that individual.

data.abilityDescription: Fara was born with animalistic yellow eyes and sharp claws instead of fingernails. She can use these traits to her advantage, enhancing her senses and increasing her fighting skills.
data.level1Description: Activate your animal vision, allowing you to see heat sources through walls for a short time.
data.level2Description: Falling back costs no Focus.
data.level3Description: Instantly pass a Strength (Climbing) check. This cannot be used after you rolled.
data.level4Description: You gain the Brawling weapon skill, and your unarmed attacks now deal 2D3 Slashing damage.
data.level5Description: Choose either Perception (Seeing), Perception (Smelling) or Perception (Hearing). You gain two ranks in whatever specialty you choose.

data.abilityDescription: Your family support you, and have written letters urging you on and expressing their pride. In frustrating or sad situations, you can bring out these letters and read them to buoy your spirits.
data.level1Description: Read an inspiring letter from your family, allowing you to have another go at a check you have failed. This can only be done in a situation where you can take out and read the letter.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: The Sirens are capable of disabling electrical devices with a touch, and can even shut down whole space stations and ships, although disabling a device of this size alone causes considerable pain and is a challenge for all but the most skilled sirens.
data.level1Description: Touch an electrical device, disabling it. Every few minutes, or two rounds if in combat, you must make an Endurance (Pain) check to continue disabling the device. The difficulty of this check can range from 1-40, depending on how large and complex the device is, and how long you have been disabling the device (with the check getting harder the longer the device is disabled).

data.abilityDescription: You go all in, either succeeding greatly, or failing massively, with much less room for neutral outcomes.
data.level1Description: You now critically succeed on a natural 17, 18, 19 or 20, but critically fail on a 1, 2 or 3.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: You can peer through time, seeing into the future or the past and allowing you to view events relating to a person or location. As your skill grows, you can hone your visions and include others in them.
data.level1Description: Have a vision relating to your current location, or an individual you are touching. You can specify whether you wish the vision to be of the future (the future seen is the most likely future if things continue on their current path), or the past, but cannot otherwise determine when or what you see. When having a vision, you appear in the middle of the vision, and cannot be seen or affect anything in the vision. You are the only one who sees the vision, and whilst you are having a vision, you cannot act or see what is happening outside of the vision.
data.level2Description: When you have a vision, you can now specify a particular event or time period to see that relates to the location or person the vision is focused around, assuming you know the event or time period in question.
data.level3Description: If there is physical evidence of an event, such as a bloodstain, signed document or scar on a person, you can now choose to have a vision of the event involving that evidence, even if you do not know the event or time period. The physical evidence must still be related to your current location or a person you are touching.
data.level4Description: You can now choose to include everyone around you in your vision, allowing them to see the vision as well. This must be done before the vision starts.
data.level5Description: You can now have a vision relating to a location you are not at, or a person who you are not touching, assuming you know the name of the person or location. This follows the rules of a normal vision, and costs 17 Focus.

data.abilityDescription: You have trained in the use of large, two-handed weapons. Whilst your attacks are slow and inaccurate, when you do hit, you devastate your opponent, dealing incredible damage.
data.level1Description: When wielding a two-handed melee weapon, you can spend X Focus before you launch an attack to suffer a -X modifier to your Strength (Attacking) check, up to a maximum of -5. If you hit, you deal an extra X damage. This does not take an action to do but must be done before you roll to hit. The other levels of this ability can also only be used when wielding a two-handed melee weapon.
data.level2Description: When you hit an enemy, you deal two extra damage if you are at the end of the turn order.
data.level3Description: If in a single attack, you deal damage equal or above your weapons normal max damage (i.e. 8 damage or above with a D8 weapon), then you can spend 5 Focus to lower the armour of the enemy you attacked by 1 for the rest of the combat. This effect can stack and doesn’t take an action to do.
data.level4Description: When you attack an enemy, you can spend 6 Focus and use your minor action to imbue the blow with extra strength, making a Strength (Might) check against your enemy’s Endurance (Impact). If you succeed, the enemy takes extra damage equal to the difference between the check results. If you fail, your Dexterity is reduced by the difference between the check results for one round.
data.level5Description: When using Level 1 of this ability, there is now no limit on the negative modifier you can take, and therefore no limit on the extra damage you can deal.

data.abilityDescription: You have a collection of different drugs which, when taken, enhance your skills and accuracy, although sometimes at a cost.
data.level1Description: Take a concoction that allows you to excel at anything if sufficiently motivated. For your next three non-combat checks, add your WIL stat modifier to your check, instead of the actual stat the check is in.
data.level2Description: Take a concoction that help you focus on hitting your foes at the expense of dodging. The next attack you make against an enemy automatically hits, but the next attack made against you automatically hits. This ability can be done as a minor action.
data.level3Description: Your Level 1 Drug Concoction can now apply to combat checks. Decide whether you want the ability to apply to combat checks or not each time before you use the ability.
data.level4Description: When you next sleep, you restore double Health, but no Focus, or double Focus, but no Health. You decide which option each time before you use this ability.
data.level5Description: When using your Level 2 Drug Concoction, you can spend an extra 4 Focus (9 in total) so that the next attack made against you no longer automatically hits.

data.abilityDescription: Being a pirate, Captain Harrison has the inexplicable ability to find more gold than anyone else, even in the most unlikely of places.
data.level1Description: When you loot a corpse, any currency you find is doubled. This ability does not work if you place gold repeatedly on a corpse, or otherwise try to game the system.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: Be it a naturally produced poison or an artificial drug in a syringe, you are in possession of a damaging toxin that can knock out weak or frail individuals.
data.level1Description: Inject a target in melee range of you with a toxin that, every round, deals D4 damage, ignoring armour and forces them to make an 8+ Endurance (Toxicity) check. This lasts for four rounds. If the target hits 0 Health or below, or fails any of the Disease checks, they pass out for an hour.

data.abilityDescription:
You carry with you cylinders of nanites that manipulate the proteins and hormones around your muscles, increasing your strength. In emergencies, these can also be used to keep you going, hardening your skin and allowing you to temporarily ignore grievous wounds.
(This ability has additional supporting information)
data.level1Description: Inject up to 3 cylinders of nanites into yourself. Each cylinder gives you a +2 to Strength for an hour, with the Strength bonuses stacking with multiple cylinders. Injecting 1 cylinder has no negative effect. Injecting 2 means you make a 12+ Willpower (Resistance) check. Injecting 3 means you make a 17+ Willpower (Resistance) check. Failing one of these checks afflicts you with a random Nanite Overdose effect.
data.level2Description: You can now inject up to 4 cylinders. Injecting all four afflicts you with a random Nanite Overdose effect.
data.level3Description: If you have at least one cylinder of nanites injected into you, you can cancel the strength bonus of a cylinder to reduce the damage of an attack made against you by 4. This afflicts you with a random Nanite Overdose effect. You can cancel multiple cylinders to reduce the damage of a single attack multiple times, although you will suffer multiple Nanite Overdose effects. This doesn’t take an action to do and can be done after the damage is rolled.
data.level4Description: You can now inject others with your nanites for 11 Focus. You can inject a willing target without making a check, or an unwilling target by passing a Strength (Might) check against their Dexterity (Dodging).
data.level5Description: If you are downed, you can Spend 4 Focus to inject yourself with a cylinder of nanites to delay your going down by one round.This afflicts you with a random Nanite Overdose effect and does not give you the Strength bonus a nanite cylinder normally would. This can be done as a minor action.

data.abilityDescription: You are able to shake off a multitude of negative effects, reducing the potency of poisons, intimidating foes and magical effects alike.
data.level1Description: Reduce a negative stat modifier applied to you by X/2. This can only be used to reduce or eliminate negative stat modifiers applied to you by others, and not to boost your stats.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: When fighting, you are careful to only use the exact amount of force needed, changing from target to target to ensure that you deal the most damage possible.
data.level1Description: When you kill an enemy, any leftover damage can be applied to another enemy in attackable range. This does not chain further if that enemy also dies with leftover damage.

data.abilityDescription: You give a rousing speech to a failing ally, bolstering their resolve and motivating them to push themselves to greater feats.
data.level1Description: When an ally makes a check, add your CHA modifier to their roll. You can only use this three times a day. This does not take an action to do in combat and can be done after the ally rolls for the check.

data.abilityDescription: Either as a natural trait of your species, or as a result of a herbal concoction, you have no scent, making you hard to locate for animals that rely on their sense of smell.
data.level1Description: All Perception (Smelling) checks against you automatically fail.

data.abilityDescription: You summon a glowing magical creature that can fly through the sky. Telepathically bonded to you, you can mentally command the familiar, see through its eyes and even use it as a magical bomb.
data.level1Description: Release a movable, flying magic familiar at your location. The familiar lasts for ten minutes and will go where you direct it. You can see through your familiar’s eyes.
data.level2Description: Release a movable, flying magic familiar at your location. The familiar lasts for ten minutes and will go where you direct it. You can see through your familiar’s eyes and mentally command it.
data.level3Description: Release a movable, flying magic familiar at your location. The familiar lasts for an hour and will go where you direct it. You can see through your familiar’s eyes and mentally command it.
data.level4Description: You can now attach your 10-Focus familiar to an enemy, preventing that enemy from attacking as long as it is attached. The familiar can be repelled with a 15+ Willpower (Resistance) check (this check can be attempted once per round), or with a successful attack made against it by another target. Any attacks made against the familiar that miss hit the target the familiar is attached to unless the attacker passes an 11+ Luck check.
data.level5Description: If a familiar is attached to a target for two rounds, you can detonate the familiar on your turn as a minor action, destroying the familiar and dealing 2D10 damage to the target it is attached to.

data.abilityDescription: Using simple mechanical parts you carry on your person, you can create a number of helpful, albeit short-lived items and gadgets that can be used to aid you and your allies, including lights, cannons and forcefields.
data.level1Description: Create a small, mechanical light that hovers just above the ground and lights up the area in all directions around it to the same degree an ordinary torch would. The light lasts for 2 hours after it was created, at which point it breaks.
data.level2Description: Create a Health Equaliser that you can hook up to two willing allies, including yourself. The two allies Health is combined and then split evenly between the two of them. The Health Equaliser must be used immediately after being created, does not take an action to use, and breaks after one use.
data.level3Description: Create a 3 metre, extendable ladder, that can be used to access previously inaccessible areas and climb without requiring a check. The ladder breaks 15 minutes after being created.
data.level4Description: Create and fire a small sound cannon at an enemy. The enemy must make a 12+ Endurance (Impact) check. If they fail then they lose their next major action. If they succeed then they lose their next minor action. The sound cannon breaks after being used.
data.level5Description: Create a forcefield with X Health at your location. When any allies within melee range of the forcefield takes damage, the forcefield takes the damage instead. The forcefield cannot be healed and when it hits zero Health, or the combat encounter ends, the forcefield is destroyed.

data.abilityDescription: Blessed with an affinity for animals, you are able to summon one to assist you, with the exact animal being linked to a habitat you have a particular link to, whether it is your home habitat, one you spent a lot of time in, or one you wish to live in.
data.level1Description: Pick a habitat associated with your character when you first get this ability. You can summon an animal from that habitat to assist you for an hour. The exact animal depends on how much Focus you spend, with larger, more powerful beasts costing more Focus. The animal can assist you with a variety of tasks in or out of combat, depending on the animal, and will listen to your commands.

data.abilityDescription: Using fairly basic holographic technology, you make yourself appear as another species. This is used by researchers on other planets and travellers to fit in more with other species but is easily detectable by any space-age civilisation.
data.level1Description: Pick a species. You can spend 3 Focus to make yourself appear as that species. This is an aesthetic-only change. You still retain any non-species-specific traits (whether you are tall, skinny etc.), as well as any identifying features such as scars, tattoos etc. This hologram is detectable using basic technology from any space-age civilisation.

data.abilityDescription: You have syringes full of DNA bombs, genetically engineered viruses that temporarily rewrite a target’s DNA when remotely activated, negating your target’s skills and abilities.
data.level1Description: When you successfully grapple an enemy, you can implant a DNA bomb into them. The DNA bomb can be detonated as a minor action to reduce all of the target’s stats to zero for two rounds. You can have up to three DNA bombs in existence at one time, and can detonate multiple DNA bombs as a single minor action.
data.level2Description: You can now implant a DNA bomb in a target you have passed a Stealth check against. This does not take an action to do, and does not alert the target.
data.level3Description: Your DNA bomb now negates all abilities in your target, preventing them from being used, for one round.
data.level4Description: There is now no limit on how many DNA bombs you can have in existence at one time.
data.level5Description: You can now contaminate food and drink, causing a DNA bomb to be implanted in anyone who ingests it.

data.abilityDescription: Your spirit flows into a target of your choice, supressing their free will and allowing you to control their body as if it was your own.
data.level1Description: Allows you to see through the eyes of anyone you can see. This can be chained. This lasts for two minutes before you must change target or cancel the ability.
data.level2Description: Possess a non-sapient creature that you can see that has a Max Health of 10 or less. You control the creature as if it was your own body. Your body remains in place and cannot be controlled whilst you are possessing someone. The possession lasts for one hour, or until the creature you are possessing is killed, at which point you regain consciousness in your own body.
data.level3Description: You can now use Level 2 of this ability to possess a willing sapient being in the same way as you would a creature. You can possess a willing sapient being regardless of their Max Health.
data.level4Description: You can now use Level 2 of this ability to possess an unwilling but unconscious sapient being with a Max Health of 15 or less for five minutes.
data.level5Description: Possess any being you can see. If the being is unwilling to be possessed, then you must make a Willpower (Presence) check against their Willpower (Resistance) check when possessing them, and every five minutes after. You control the being as if it was your own body. Your body remains in place and cannot be controlled whilst you are possessing someone. The possession can last for one hour, or until the being you are possessing is killed, at which point you regain consciousness in your own body.

data.abilityDescription: You rejuvenate an ally with a healing salve, injection or device, slowly knitting their wounds together and healing them over a period of time.
data.level1Description: Heal a target within melee range of you for D4 Health, then for an extra 2 Health on their turn for three rounds.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A
data.level5Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: You unleash all of your strength, slamming your feet down onto the ground with enough force to create a powerful shockwave that shakes the ground around you.
data.level1Description: Stamp your legs on the ground, unleashing a shockwave that deals D4+1 to all enemies in melee range of you.
data.level2Description: Stamp your legs on the ground, unleashing a shockwave that deals D4+1 to all enemies in melee range of you, knocks them down (requiring a minor action to get back up) and disarms them.
data.level3Description: Instead of knocking down or disarming enemies, your stomp can now knock them a turn away from you.
data.level4Description: Stamp your legs on the ground, unleashing a shockwave that deals D4+3 to all enemies in melee range of you, knocks them down (requiring a minor action to get back up) and disarms them.
data.level5Description: When using this ability, instead of dealing damage to each enemy, add together all the damage you would deal, and distribute it at will between all enemies at melee. An enemy must have at least 1 damage dealt to it to be knocked down and disarmed.

data.abilityDescription: You use high-tech bullets, capable of homing in on enemies and going around corners. When embedded in an enemy, a tracker in the bullet can also be activated, allowing you to know their location.
data.level1Description: When you successfully hit an enemy with an attack from a firearm, you can spend 3 Focus to activate a tracker in the bullet, allowing you to track that enemy’s location for twenty minutes as long as they stay within three miles.
data.level2Description: When you launch an attack, you can fire a dampened homing bullet which automatically hits, but only deals 1 damage. You must decide to do this before you roll to hit. An attack using a dampened homing bullet can be done as a minor action. This counts as an attack.
data.level3Description:
The tracker in your smart tracking bullets now allows you to track an enemy for 6 hours.
OR
The tracker in your smart tracking bullets now allows you to track an enemy up to a range of 50 miles.
data.level4Description: Your bullets can change direction once mid-flight, allowing you to attack enemies around corners without suffering a penalty to hit, although you must still roll as with a normal attack.
data.level5Description: Level 1 of this ability is now a passive effect with no cost, with all enemies hit by your bullets able to be tracked.

data.abilityDescription: After being betrayed, Maria is now intensely paranoid, and is always expecting an attack. This makes her incredibly hard to surprise, and she is always ready to launch a counterattack, or flee if things go badly.
data.level1Description: You have a +4 to Perception (Seeing) or Perception (Hearing) checks when rolling to detect enemies in Stealth.
data.level2Description: You can spend 5 Focus to attempt to flee as a minor action.
data.level3Description: When an enemy launches a Stealth attack against you, or uses a surprise attack to initiate combat with your group, you deal 3 damage to them, ignoring armour. This damage is dealt even if the Stealth attack against you misses.
data.level4Description: When you are about to take damage from a stealth attack, spend 4 Focus to change the stealth attack from a critical hit to an ordinary hit.
data.level5Description: You always go first in the turn order, even against enemies who have initiated combat with a surprise attack. Stealth attacks against you will still go before you.

data.abilityDescription: As a vampire, Maria is equipped with sharp fangs that she can use to pierce a target’s skin and drain the blood from them. This blood sustains her, and can even sharpen her concentration and heal her wounds.
data.level1Description: When you successfully grapple a target, spend 3 extra Focus to bite them and drain some of their blood, dealing 3 damage, ignoring armour, and giving you a +1 to your sustenance rating. This ability does not take an action to do.
data.level2Description: When you fail to grapple a target, you can spend 3 extra Focus to quickly drain a small amount of blood from them, dealing 2 damage, ignoring armour, and giving you a +0.5 to your sustenance rating. This ability does not take an action to do.
data.level3Description: When you drain blood from a target, you heal for 2 Health.
data.level4Description: If at the start of your turn, you are grappling an enemy, you can now spend 3 Focus to drain blood from them, dealing 3 damage, ignoring armour, and giving you a +1 to your sustenance rating. This ability does not take an action to do and can only be done once a round.
data.level5Description:
When you drain the blood from an enemy, you can spend 1 extra Focus to do one of the following. Only one of these can be done at a time and this doesn’t take an action to do:
Deal an extra 2 damage to the enemy.
Restore double the amount of sustenance you normally would
Heal for 4 Health instead of 2.

data.abilityDescription: One of the many poisons found in Demorena is Bloodrage, a poison that drives those infected into a manic, but short-lived frenzy, causing them to lash out at anyone nearby, regardless of their allegiances.
data.level1Description: Hit a target up to one turn away with a Bloodrage Dart. On that target’s next turn, they attack a random target within attackable range.

data.abilityDescription: Ti’Giq’, whilst not trained in a great variety of things, is incredibly determined, and can push himself to great lengths to succeed in any given task, although this leaves him exhausted.
data.level1Description: Whenever you need to make a check, you can spend 3 Focus to give yourself a result of 15. This has to be used before rolling for the check and you cannot roll for the check after using this. Every time you use this ability, you suffer a -1 to your overall Needs system result when you next sleep.

data.level1Description: You have a +4 to any rolls involving fishing, and any food you cook that involves aquatic animals provides 1 more sustenance.
