data.abilityDescription:
You can transform corpses and unlucky living victims into Pumpkin Spawn, mindless servants that will follow your commands and obey you until death. Consuming these spawn transforms you into a durable, strong Pumpkin warrior atop a terrifying steed.

Requires a method of obtaining souls
(This ability has additional supporting information)
data.level1Description: Implant a seed into a dead body. After 12 hours, a pumpkin will appear on their head. After 24 hours they will have transformed into a Pumpkin Spawn (more information on the Pumpkin Spawn can be found in its mob sheet). You can only have five Pumpkin Spawn at one time.
data.level2Description: The transformation into a spawn now happens over 12 hours, with the pumpkin appearing after six hours.
data.level3Description: You can now transform a living thing into a Pumpkin spawn, assuming they have 6 Health or less, and have no stat modifier greater than a +2. When you implant a seed into a living thing, it will transform in a similar way to a dead body, losing its independence when the pumpkin appears on its head, and following your commands when fully transformed. However, if the pumpkin can be destroyed with two successful attacks whilst the transformation is ongoing, the person will be freed and will no longer transform into a spawn.
data.level4Description: There is now no limit on the number of Pumpkin Spawn you can have at one time.
data.level5Description: All of your Pumpkin Spawn are destroyed. For each Pumpkin Spawn destroyed, you gain 3 Health, 3 Focus, +1 STR, and your attacks deal +1 damage. You also materialise a large horse that you can ride (the horse has no stats or free will). These effects last for ten minutes for each spawn destroyed.

data.abilityDescription: You put everything you have into a task, almost certainly ensuring your success, although this takes great effort.
data.level1Description: You can use an Overcharge to change the result of one of your checks to a 20.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A
data.level5Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: You are adept at making deals to obtain people’s souls, playing off their desires and fears to trick them into disadvantageous contracts.
data.level1Description: You can obtain someone’s soul if they willingly sign a written contract agreeing to give you their soul. However, you must abide by any conditions written on the contract and cannot lie about the contents of the contract, although you can use misleading language. You can use up 1 Soul to increase the result of a check by 3, heal for 6 health or restore 9 Focus. Using a soul in this way is a minor action. If either side does not hold up their end of the contract, their Max Health and Max Focus is permanently halved.
data.level2Description:
See through the eyes of someone who has given you their soul for fifteen minutes. During this time you can mentally communicate with them.
You can also now spend 3 Souls to gain an Overcharge as a minor action.
data.level3Description: You can now obtain souls through verbal contracts. These work in the same way as written contracts in terms of conditions. The target must willingly and verbally agree to give you their soul, then make physically contact with you within ten minutes of the agreement in order for you to obtain their soul.
data.level4Description: See into a target’s mind, learning basic information about either their greatest regret, greatest desire or greatest fear.
data.level5Description: You can now add up to five words of fine print to your contract, altering the way it works. These words cannot completely negate an aspect of your contract but can alter it. The fine print can be seen with a 16+ Perception (Seeing) check.

data.abilityDescription: You cloak yourself, disappearing right in front of enemies’ eyes and allowing you to sneak around, steal items and, as you grow stronger, attack from the shadows.
data.level1Description: You become invisible for two minutes, with all stealth checks you make during that time having a minimum final result of at least 16. You can use non-combat actions and non-combat items whilst stealthed in this way, although any aggressive actions will drop you out of Stealth, with an attack done in this way not counting as a Stealth attack.
data.level2Description: Enemies can now no longer use Perception (Seeing) checks to see through your invisibility and must use Perception (Hearing) or (Smelling).
data.level3Description: When invisible, you can spend 2 Focus to attack an enemy, performing a Stealth attack. This still drops you out of Stealth after the attack has taken place.
data.level4Description: Your invisibility no longer costs 6 Focus and no longer last for two minutes. Your cloak now lasts as long as you want, but costs 2 Focus per minute to maintain.
data.level5Description: You extend your invisibility to a number of targets around you, at a cost of 5 Focus per target. Invisibility only affects other targets for two minutes, and any aggressive actions other invisible targets perform will drop them out of Stealth, with an attack done in this way not counting as a Stealth attack.

data.abilityDescription: You have spent your life fighting, launching devastating attacks, pillaging and looting your foes, then escaping in your ship before they can retaliate.
data.level1Description: You have a +1 to Strength (Attacking) and Dexterity (Dodging) checks when in combat.
data.level2Description: Instantly pass an Endurance (Swimming) or Dexterity (Piloting) check. This must be done before you roll for the check.
data.level3Description:
When you loot a corpse, any currency you find is increased by 50%.

This ability does not work if you place money repeatedly on a corpse, or otherwise try to game the system.
data.level4Description: You are skilled in all weapon groups.
data.level5Description: You critically hit on an 18 or 19 as well as a 20.

data.abilityDescription: You are in possession of a sentient weapon, whether it is a gun with an inbuilt AI, or a magical beast that takes the form of an enchanted blade. Whilst powerful, the weapon is symbiotically bonded to you, meaning that being apart from it causes incredible damage and can even kill you.
data.level1Description: You are bonded with a sentient weapon (the type of weapon is up to your GM). The damage of this weapon is 2+ a number of D8 equal to your level divided by 5, rounded up. The weapon is alive and can communicate telepathically with you. If you are ever separated from your weapon, you take damage equal to 1/3 of your Max health a round. This damage is dealt even if you are downed.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A
data.level5Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: You have the eyes of a predator, and can see heat sources, allowing you to pick out animals, and people, hidden in the vegetation.
data.level1Description: You can see heat sources and infrared heat signatures for one minute. You cannot move whilst your Thermal Vision is active.
data.level2Description: You can now move whilst your Thermal Vision is active.
data.level3Description: Your Thermal Vision now lasts for ten minutes.
data.level4Description: When activating your Thermal Vision, you can spend an extra 2 Focus to see heat sources even through a surface, although you cannot see them if they are behind multiple surfaces.
data.level5Description: Your Thermal vision is now always active as a permanent passive effect. Level 4 of this ability is now activated independently to allow you to see heat sources through a single surface for ten minutes.

data.abilityDescription: You whistle a command, and your trusty eagle Dagmar swoops in, clawing at an enemy’s eyes.
data.level1Description: Direct Dagmar to attack a target, dealing 5 damage, and an extra 3 damage a turn for three rounds. This attack cannot miss.
data.level2Description: N/A
data.level3Description: N/A
data.level4Description: N/A
data.level5Description: N/A

data.abilityDescription: A cloud of noxious spores emanates from your body, obfuscating your form and forming a dense layer that swirls around anyone who gets too close, choking their lungs and eating away at their flesh.
data.level1Description: Activate your shield of spores. Any enemy who enters melee range with you is enveloped in the spores, and must make a 12+ Endurance (Toxicity) check every round until they succeed. This check does not count as an action. If they fail, they take 2 damage and become blinded (-5 to Strength (Attacking) checks and automatically fail all Perception (Seeing) checks) until the start of their next turn. When they succeed, they are immune to the effects of your spores for the rest of the battle.
data.level2Description: Instead of dealing damage, you can choose to reduce one of your enemy’s stats by 2 until the start of their next turn when they are afflicted by your spores.
data.level3Description: Your Shield of Spores now deals D6 damage.
data.level4Description: Enemies must now pass a 15+ Endurance (Toxicity) check to not become affected by your spores.
data.level5Description:
Your Shield of Spores now affects an area up to one turn away from you.
OR
The first time an enemy passes a disease check against your spores, they are only protected for a round and must continue to roll toxicity checks on their turn until they pass again.

data.abilityDescription: As an Old Human Cyborg, you are powered by Old Human Blood, blood that has the power to rewrite reality itself, granting you incredibly abilities. As you use this blood, your lifeforce weakens.
data.level1Description: You are powered and sustained through Ancient Blood. Your maximum Blood is equal to your level +1. Your Max Health is always your current Blood times 4. You can use 1 Blood to remove the Focus cost of an ability or use 1 Blood as an overcharge. Your Blood refills to full at the end of each day.
data.level2Description: When you make a deal or promise with someone and shake on it, you can use 2 Blood to bind the deal. If either side breaks the terms of the deal once it is bound, then they are reduced to -6 Health, and are immediately downed.
data.level3Description: When you attack, you can spend 2 Blood to deal maximum weapon damage. You can only do this before rolling damage. This doesn’t take an action to do.
data.level4Description: You can spend 1 Blood to gain another minor action, and 2 Blood to gain another major action. This doesn’t take an action to do.
data.level5Description: You can now use Blood to give an ally any of the bonuses previously mentioned in this ability (Using Blood instead of a Focus cost, using Blood as an overcharge, using Blood to bind a deal, using Blood to deal maximum weapon damage, using Blood to gain more actions. Using Blood on an ally in this way uses up your next minor action.

data.abilityDescription: As opposed to weakening you, pain and damage only empower you. Whether through your own strength of will, magical effects or implanted cybernetics, the more damage you take, the stronger you become.
data.level1Description: When in combat, you have a +2 to Strength if you took damage the previous round. This bonus only applies if you have been damaged by an enemy with hostile intent or a natural hazard, not by yourself or an ally.
data.level2Description: When an enemy deals a critical hit to you, you are cleared of any tiredness debuffs.
data.level3Description: Your increase to strength now gives you a +4 to Strength if you took damage every round for the last two rounds, and +6 to Strength if you took damage every round for the last three rounds.
data.level4Description: If you lose more than a third of your Health in a single attack, your next attack gets a +7 to hit and is a critical hit if it hits.
data.level5Description: When you hit zero Health or below, instead of being downed, you gain +4 Strength and can continue to perform all actions as if you weren’t downed. However, you will still die after a number of rounds equal to 1+ your WIL modifier if not healed above zero Health, and if killed, you are still dead as normal.

data.abilityDescription: You can see people’s destiny, both the events of their past that made them who they are today, and their final fate if things do not change.
data.level1Description: When looking at someone, have a vision of either their most defining event in the past, or their most likely eventual fate, assuming things continue on their current path. When having a vision, you appear in the middle of the vision, and cannot be seen or affect anything in the vision. You are the only one who sees the vision, and whilst you are having a vision, you cannot act or see what is happening outside of the vision.

data.abilityDescription: In his spare time, Kratom likes to prepare a variety of gaseous drugs that he can use in his respirator to boost his effectiveness
data.level1Description: Inhale a concoction that allows you to excel at anything if sufficiently motivated. For your next three non-combat checks, add your WIL stat modifier to your check, instead of the actual stat the check is in.
data.level2Description: Inhale a concoction that help you focus on hitting your foes at the expense of dodging. The next attack you make against an enemy automatically hits, but the next attack made against you automatically hits. This ability can be done as a minor action.
data.level3Description: Your Level 1 Drug Inhalation can now apply to combat checks. Decide whether you want the ability to apply to combat checks or not each time before you use the ability.
data.level4Description: When you next sleep, you restore double Health, but no Focus, or double Focus, but no Health. You decide which option each time before you use this ability.
data.level5Description: When using your Level 2 Drug Inhalation, you can spend an extra 4 Focus (9 in total) so that the next attack made against you no longer automatically hits.

data.abilityDescription: A runed item, they are popular amongst the Barbarian Clans. The bracers turn your skin to bark, with the thickness of the bark depending on the duration of the effect.
data.level1Description: Your skin turns to hard bark for 5 rounds, or 30 minutes if used out of combat. This gives you 1 Natural armour, and 4 temporary health.
data.level2Description: The bark now changes to resemble nearby trees, giving you a +4 to any Dexterity (Stealth) checks when the bracers are active in areas with lots of trees.
data.level3Description: Your bracers now give you 2 Natural Armour.
data.level4Description: Your skin turns to hard bark for 5 rounds, or 30 minutes if used out of combat. This gives you 2 Natural armour, and 4 temporary health. The bark changes to resemble nearby trees, giving you a +4 to any Dexterity (Stealth) checks when in areas with lots of trees. Any enemy who hits you in melee combat whilst the bracers are active takes 2 damage, ignoring armour.
data.level5Description:
When you activate this ability, you can reduce the time your bracers are active for to empower its effects. You may use as many of these as you wish and stack the same empowerment.
-1 round / -6 minutes: +1 extra Natural Armour
-1 round / -6 minutes: +2 damage to attackers
-1 round / -6 minutes: +3 temporary health

data.abilityDescription: You are always the first to enter battle, charging into the ranks of your enemies, either alone or as part of a squad.
data.level1Description: You can now Charge a target up to two turns away.
data.level2Description: Charge no longer has a Focus cost.
data.level3Description: You can now Charge for full damage.
data.level4Description: When combat begins, you can spend 3 Focus to Charge an enemy, putting yourself first in the turn order and using up your major action. You cannot do this if you were surprised.
data.level5Description: When you Charge an enemy, you can bring any willing allies within melee range of you with you, at a cost of 3 Focus per ally. Each ally deals D3 damage to the target of your Charge, regardless of whether or not your Charge hits.

data.abilityDescription: You spray an enemy with a blast of noxious gas, which can weaken, and disorientate them. If done carefully, this can be done covertly weakening enemies without them even realising.
data.level1Description: Spray an enemy within one turn of you with a blast of poisonous gas, reducing either their Intelligence, Willpower, Perception or Charisma by 3 for three rounds, or five minutes if out of combat. Which stat is reduced is up to the players. This can be done without alerting the target if the player passes a 12+ Dexterity (Stealth) check.
data.level2Description: You can now use your Debilitating Gas to reduce an enemy’s Strength, Endurance or Dexterity. This reduction works in the same way as Level 1.
data.level3Description: Instead of reducing a stat of your choice, you can now use your Debilitating Gas to reduce an enemies Focus by 4+D6. This reduction lasts for three rounds or five minutes if out of combat, and can be done without alerting the target if the player passes a 12+ Dexterity (Stealth) check.
data.level4Description: You can now use your Debilitating Gas to reduce the damage an enemy deals by two for three rounds. This damage reduction is taken into account before armour and cannot be done without alerting the target.
data.level5Description: When you use Debilitating Gas, you can now choose two effects from the previous levels to afflict a target with.

data.abilityDescription: Whilst Vitrya is dead, it is still possible to be blessed with her power, either through discovering a long-lost artifact that imbues you with her power, or through an infusion of power at the remains of one of her Vales.
data.level1Description: You can emit a constant, faint light from your body, negating any Perception penalties due to low light or darkness. This light is on by default but can be turned on and off at will.
data.level2Description: Touch an object and imbue it with light, causing it to glow with a colour of your choice. The glow is bright, illuminating the surrounding area, but is not bright enough to blind someone. The light lasts for ten minutes, and you can end the light early without using an action.
data.level3Description: When looking at someone, or at a photorealistic depiction of someone, you can spend 4 Focus to get a broad sense of their moral character.
data.level4Description: Mark a being or object with a magical light. For 24 hours, that being or object leaves a glowing trail behind it, as well as glowing marks on anything it comes into contact with. This light can only be seen by you.
data.level5Description: You can say the name of a living being, allowing you to see where they are and what they are doing in your mind’s eye for one minute. Only you can see the target. You can continue to act normally and carry out other actions whilst viewing your target.

data.abilityDescription: You delve into your target’s psyche, reading their thoughts and intentions, and even their mind, learning what they know and sifting through their memories for information.
data.level1Description: Instantly pass a Perception (Empathy) check. This can be done after rolling for the check.
data.level2Description: Read a target’s mind, learning their current intentions towards you.
data.level3Description: Read a target’s mind, learning their current thought.
data.level4Description: Read a target’s mind, learning their next action.
data.level5Description: Delve through someone’s mind whilst thinking of a question. If the target knows the answer, then you learn it, unless they pass an 18+ Willpower (Self-Discipline). This ability does not cost anything if they pass the check, but you cannot attempt to learn the answer to that question from that person for eight hours and they are aware you tried to read their mind.

data.abilityDescription: You are capable of generating electricity, able to fire it in powerful bolts, prolonged streams and even turn your body into electricity to travel instantaneously.
data.level1Description: Imbue a metal weapon with lightning, causing it’s next attack to deal D6 additional damage. This costs a minor action to use.
data.level2Description: Teleport in a bolt of lightning to any location within three turns of you. You deal 2 damage to any enemies within melee range of you when you land.
data.level3Description: Target an enemy within one turn of you and spend both your major and minor action to begin charging a bolt of lightning. On your next turn, spend your major and minor actions to launch a bolt of lightning at an enemy. The bolt of lightning cannot miss and deals 4D6 damage. You can cancel your bolt of lightning on your second turn instead of firing it, causing it to cost no Focus.
data.level4Description: Shoot a stream of electricity at an enemy within one turn of you, automatically grappling them. Whilst they are grappled, they take D4 damage on their turn, ignoring armour. Unlike a normal grapple, you do not suffer a -2 penalty to your Endurance (Fatigue) every round you are grappling the target, and the target must roll Endurance (Pain) instead of Strength (Might) to try and escape the grapple. You can cancel this grapple at any time as a minor action.
data.level5Description: When you use your Level 3 Lightning Magic, you can spend 5 Focus to chain your lightning bolt to another target. This can be used multiple times to chain the bolt to additional enemies. The bolt deals 1D6 less damage for each target it is chained to, meaning it cannot be used to damage more than 4 enemies in total. This can be chained back to the same target, given there is another target to chain off.

data.abilityDescription:
You wield a specially-made runic weapon, based on the designs of the ancient Elder Dynasty. This weapon is designed to hold a large number of runes, and these runes can be enhanced in a number of ways, although only a runecarver can make full use of the weapon.

Requires Runecarver ability
data.level1Description: Your starting weapon is a runic weapon designed for runecarving that has three rune slots on it.
data.level2Description:
One of the rune slots on your runic weapon is enhanced with a rune of potency (the rune of potency does not take up a rune slot). This increases the power of the rune slot (equivalent to if two runes of the same effect were carved on the item).
Removing runes from your runic weapon now opens up the rune slot, allowing another rune to be carved in its place.
data.level3Description: Your runic weapon gains two additional rune slots. These slots are enhanced with runes of alacrity, meaning that rune can be activated as a minor action if it was previously a major action, or two runes enhanced with runes of alacrity can be activated as a single minor action if both were previously minor actions.
data.level4Description: Your runic weapon gains two additional rune slots. You may empower a rune slot on your runic weapon with either a rune of potency or a rune of alacrity.
data.level5Description: You may use an Overcharge to temporarily boost the power of one of the runes on your runic weapon. The manner in which your rune’s power is boosted can vary, much like how an Overcharge normally boosts an ability use.

data.level1Description: Automatically pass an Intelligence (Nature) check that relates to plants. This can be done after rolling for the check.

data.level4Description: See the publicly available floorplan for a building you are in or next to.
data.level5Description: Learn basic, publicly available information about someone you can see.

data.abilityDescription: You take advantage of your enemies rushed attacks to slip through their defences, striking them more accurately and dealing more damage.
data.level1Description: If you were hit with an attack last round, spend 4 Focus to add 2 damage to your attack against that enemy. This must be done before rolling to hit and does not take an action to do.
data.level2Description: If you were hit with an attack last round, spend 4 Focus to add 2 damage to your attack against that enemy. This must be done before rolling to hit and does not take an action to do. This ability only costs 1 Focus if your attack misses.
data.level3Description: If you were hit with an attack last round, spend 4 Focus to gain a +3 to hit that target this round and add 2 damage to your attack against that enemy. This must be done before rolling to hit and does not take an action to do. This ability only costs 2 Focus if your attack misses.
data.level4Description: If you are downed by an enemy attack, you can immediately use a level of this ability. This does not take an action to do, but the ability still costs Focus.
data.level5Description: After using a previous level of this ability, you can use it again against another enemy that hit you last round. Using the ability again does not take an action. You can use this to attack every enemy who hit you last turn. The ability still costs Focus.
